items.title: Integrating large mammalian herbivores into Dynamic Global Vegetation Models: Status and next steps
items.abstract: Abstract Zoogeochemistry, the study of how animals influence elemental cycling within ecosystems, bridges the fields of zoology, ecology and biogeochemistry. Yet, most terrestrial ecosystem models, especially Dynamic Global Vegetation Models (DGVMs), remain largely plant‐centric and rarely capture animal‐driven feedbacks. This omission could lead to misrepresentation of carbon and nutrient cycling, which is particularly pertinent at a time of continued widespread defaunation but also animal introductions (trophic rewilding) gaining traction as a potential mitigation measure. Here, we review global evidence from field observations, experimental manipulations, remote sensing and modelling to understand how animals, influence carbon, nitrogen and phosphorus cycling through consumption (e.g. herbivory), transformation and redistribution (via faeces, urine and carcasses) and physical disturbances (e.g. trampling). While zoogeochemistry encompasses all animals, this review focuses primarily on terrestrial vertebrates, particularly large mammals. We then trace the historical development of how animals have been represented in contemporary DGVMs, beginning with implicit representations and progressing towards explicit representations. Persistent gaps remain in capturing key animal‐driven processes, and relating these to functional traits (body size, foraging strategy, etc.), mammal‐mediated biogeochemical cycling, animal–microbial interactions and in development of adequate model validation approaches. To address these challenges, we propose a modular framework guided by the principle of ‘complexity by necessity,’ which links trait‐based animal cohorts to above‐ and below‐ground processes through consumption, defecation and other animal‐driven inputs, capturing spatial behaviours, plant–microbe–soil interactions and predator–prey dynamics across scales. Integrating zoogeochemical mechanisms into DGVMs would replace the traditional black‐box approach to animal processes with explicit mechanistic modelling. This offers a process‐based tool to quantify local animal impacts, scale across large regions and rigorously evaluate the expected outcomes for ecosystem structure and biogeochemistry. In the future, we call for better implementation of animal interactions and habitat‐mediated feedbacks, such as behavioural effects through predation or fear (predator–prey interactions). To more accurately simulate the nutrient cycling in soil, we suggest expanding models to include interactions with soil‐engineering invertebrates and larger animals. Collectively, these improvements would advance our mechanistic understanding of animal‐driven biogeochemistry and their importance for predicting nutrient cycles and animal–plant–soil feedbacks within Earth system models. authors: Yue Cheng, Joanne Alice O'Keeffe, Andrew J. Abraham, Jesper Riis Christiansen, Frederik Nygaard Philipsen, Klaus Steenberg Larsen, Fabio Berzaghi, Carsten W. Mueller, Lars Vesterdal, Jeppe A. Kristensen, Elizabeth Le Roux
items.summary: [背景] 当前陆地生态系统模型仍以植物为中心，大型食草动物对碳、氮、磷循环的动物地球化学反馈被普遍忽略，这在动物群丧失和再野化趋势下可能导致养分循环模拟的偏差。[方法] 本文综述了全球范围内大型哺乳动物通过取食、排泄、尸体和践踏等途径影响元素循环的观测、实验和遥感证据，追溯了DGVMs中动物表达从隐式到显式的演化历程，并提出了一个基于“必要复杂性”原则的模块化框架。[发现] 1) 现有模型对动物介导的养分再分布、土壤微生物互作等关键过程表达不足；2) 基于功能性状（体型、取食策略）的动物群体可有效连接地上与地下过程；3) 需整合空间行为、捕食-猎物动态和土壤扰动来提升预测能力；4) 未来应纳入无脊椎动物和大型动物的互作以更准确模拟土壤养分循环。[贡献] 首次系统梳理了大型食草动物在DGVMs中的建模现状，提出从性状到生物地球化学的模块化方案，为地球系统模型中动物过程的显式表达提供了路线图。[局限] 该综述主要针对大型哺乳动物，未涵盖无脊椎动物和其他动物类群；框架尚待实际模拟验证；缺乏与具体生态系统管理场景的衔接。[精读] 对于从事大尺度植被模型或食草动物生态效应研究的读者，文中关于功能性状和模块化框架的部分值得精读。

items.title: Divergent long‐term trends in vegetation carbon turnover between mature and young forests
items.abstract: Abstract The terrestrial carbon sink depends not only on how much biomass forests accumulate, but also on how long that carbon remains stored in vegetation. This is known as vegetation carbon turnover time ( τ veg ), which varies with forest age, structure and climate. Furthermore, τ veg is widely expected to decline under climate change as warming and disturbance accelerate biomass loss. However, most evidence comes from mature forests, even as global forest demographics shift due to reforestation, disturbance and land‐use change. Younger forests differ in growth rates, mortality patterns and stand structure, which may create distinct turnover trajectories with rapid biomass accumulation potentially slowing τ veg . Here, we evaluated this possibility using 17 years of in situ data from a network of temperate, subtropical and tropical forest plots across China. We found that τ veg declined over time in mature forests but increased in younger ones. These opposing trends were shaped by age‐specific trade‐offs between growth and mortality, mediated by stand structure and environmental conditions. Synthesis . Our results demonstrate that forest age strongly influences vegetation carbon turnover and must be integrated into models to improve predictions of terrestrial carbon sink dynamics.

items.summary: [背景] 陆地碳汇不仅取决于森林生物量积累，还取决于碳在植被中的储存时长，即植被碳周转时间（τ_veg）。现有研究多关注成熟林，但全球森林种群结构因再造林、干扰和土地利用变化而年轻化，幼龄林的生长、死亡模式和结构差异可能导致不同的周转趋势。 [方法] 利用覆盖温带、亚热带和热带的中国森林样地网络17年原位数据，分析成熟林与幼龄林τ_veg的长期变化，并探讨生长与死亡间的权衡、林分结构和环境因子的作用。 [发现] 1) 成熟林的τ_veg随时间下降，而幼龄林则增加，二者呈相反趋势。2) 这种分异由年龄特异的生长-死亡权衡驱动，并受林分结构和环境条件调节。3) 幼龄林快速生物量积累可能减缓τ_veg，挑战了气候变化下τ_veg普遍下降的预期。 [贡献] 首次基于长期样地数据揭示森林年龄对τ_veg趋势的调控作用，强调在碳循环模型中加入年龄结构的重要性。 [局限] 样地覆盖中国主要气候区，但未包括其他生物群区；未详细量化干扰历史影响。 [精读] 方法部分关于τ_veg计算和生长-死亡权衡分析值得参考，但对当前核心方向无直接支持。

items.title: Environmental detection of the amphibian chytrid fungus in water bodies is associated with host infection along a deforestation gradient
items.abstract: Abstract Many wildlife pathogens can persist in the environment independently of their hosts, with the habitat itself serving as a reservoir and potential source of transmission. However, reliably detecting and quantifying free‐living pathogen stages across heterogeneous landscapes using environmental DNA methods remains challenging. Understanding how landcover and habitat structure drive pathogen distribution at the environmental and host levels is critical for advancing disease surveillance and ecology. Amphibian chytridiomycosis, caused by the fungal pathogen Batrachochytrium dendrobatidis ( Bd ), provides a useful model system to address these broader challenges, yet most studies have focused on host–pathogen interactions, with less emphasis on Bd within environmental reservoirs. Using Bd as a model system, we investigated whether pathogen distribution in natural aquatic environments is associated with host infection patterns across gradients of habitat loss. We sampled four tropical amphibian species across eight rainforest landscapes and quantified Bd in paired water and host samples using a high‐capacity water filtration method coupled with digital and real‐time quantitative polymerase chain reaction detection assays. Our results revealed a strong positive correlation between Bd DNA concentrations in water and infection loads on amphibian skin, indicating that environmental Bd DNA is associated with host infection patterns. Forest cover and habitat split (i.e. spatial separation between forests and aquatic breeding sites) were the primary predictors of Bd occurrence, concentration and infection load across environmental and host‐associated forms, and both Bd ‐GPL and Bd ‐Asia‐2/Brazil lineages were detected across our study landscapes. Our study introduces and validates a robust protocol for detecting environmental Bd , providing a scalable approach to quantify pathogen–environment associations across multiple landscapes and environmental gradients. Synthesis and applications : Linking environmental pathogen detection with host infection patterns can improve surveillance of diseases involving environmental transmission, particularly where direct host sampling is logistically challenging. This approach enables the identification of areas of elevated transmission risk and supports targeted monitoring and management under habitat loss and degradation. It also provides a practical tool to guide conservation actions in landscapes undergoing rapid land‐use change.
authors: Ananda Brito de Assis, David Rodriguez, Wesley J. Neely, Carla Martins Lopes, Paula R. Prist, Carlos Arturo Navas, Renato A. Martins, Shannon Buttimer, Célio Fernando Baptista Haddad, C. Guilherme Becker

items.title: Community Assembly Processes Change With Location and Environmental Distinctiveness in River Networks
items.abstract: ABSTRACT Aim Organisms disperse in space, thereby connecting local communities to metacommunities. Dispersal and environmental selection are two community assembly processes ultimately driving biodiversity and potentially scaling to ecosystem functioning. So far, these processes have mainly been generalized to entire metacommunities, ignoring their variability among constituent sites. This limits our understanding of community assembly in river networks, where unidirectional water flow connects, but also isolates, environmentally heterogeneous sites across the network from headwaters to large rivers. For the first time, we aimed at a site‐specific description of periphyton community assembly processes to investigate how the relative importance of dispersal and environmental selection at the local scale relates to spatial connection among sites and their environmental conditions. Location Three river networks: The Mara (Kenya), the Thur (Switzerland) and the Vjosa (Albania and Greece). Time Period We collected data during five field campaigns from January 2018 to October 2019. Major Taxa Studied Algae attached to streambed sediments (periphyton). Methods We fitted joint species distribution models to taxonomically highly resolved molecular biological datasets. We inferred the site‐specific importance of dispersal and environmental selection from effects of spatial and environmental variables on community composition. We then used generalized additive models to reveal shifts in the relative importance of assembly processes along catchment area and environmental distinctiveness. Results Environmental selection was particularly important in midsized streams and at sites with more distinct environmental conditions. Dispersal developed the greatest role in large rivers—possibly due to mass effects in well‐connected large rivers. We also found indication for dispersal limitation to affect spatially isolated headwaters in the Thur. Main Conclusions We revealed a systematic shift in assembly processes along river size and with environmental distinctiveness across all three river networks, advancing understanding and generalization of assembly processes within river networks. Sites with environmental selection result in communities that are closely linked to prevailing environmental conditions, which can enhance ecosystem functioning. The ability to identify such sites could improve biodiversity conservation and help maintain ecosystem functioning.
authors: Thomas Fuß, Lukas Thuile Bistarelli, Lauren Talluto, Rubén del Campo, Florian Altermatt, Frank O. Masese, Gabriel Singer

items.title: Highly fragmented European wetlands with uneven restoration needs
items.abstract: Nature, Published online: 15 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-10760-9 Satellite imagery and machine learning used for the mapping of six seminatural open wetland types and land-use disturbance in European countries shows that wetlands are highly fragmented and have uneven restoration needs.
items.summary: [背景] 湿地提供重要的生态系统服务，但面临农业扩张、城市化等威胁，大尺度精细制图对于保护与恢复规划至关重要。以往欧洲湿地制图在类型分辨率和空间覆盖上仍不足。[方法] 利用卫星影像与机器学习方法，对欧洲国家六种半自然开放湿地类型进行空间精准制图，并量化土地利用干扰强度，评估湿地破碎化程度与恢复需求的空间格局。[发现] 1) 欧洲湿地高度破碎化，斑块面积小且分布零散；2) 不同国家与区域间湿地面临的土地利用压力差异显著；3) 恢复需求存在明显的不均衡性，部分区域亟需优先干预。[贡献] 首次在大洲尺度上提供半自然湿地类型的高分辨率空间分布与干扰图谱，为跨国湿地保护与恢复政策提供数据支持。[局限] 论文摘要信息有限，模型精度、具体湿地类型定义、数据源及时相需查原文确认。[精读] 值得关注其遥感制图方法论与机器学习分类策略，对于生态恢复空间规划有一定方法参考价值。

items.title: Same forest, different story: Beetle community responses to non‐native tree species depend on the vertical stratum
items.abstract: Abstract Increased forest diebacks under climate change necessitate adaptation strategies of forest management, which often include the use of drought‐resistant non‐native tree species. However, their planting has raised concerns about the ecological impacts on forest biodiversity and functioning. Relevant studies are largely limited to single forest strata, often focusing on ground or subcanopy communities, which prevents a comprehensive understanding of how biodiversity responds to changes in native and non‐native tree species identity and composition across forest strata. Here, we provide a synthesis of how the introduction of North American Douglas fir alters different facets of biodiversity across vertical strata in Central European forests. We focused on beetles, a hyperdiverse group of forest biota, and considered economically important stand types including and excluding Douglas fir, namely, monocultures and mixtures of native European beech, native Norway spruce planted outside its natural range and non‐native Douglas fir. Beetle diversity varied strongly among forest strata and stand types. Douglas fir monocultures consistently supported lower taxonomic, functional and phylogenetic diversity at both local (plot) and regional (landscape) scales compared with the other stand types, with the most pronounced differences observed in the canopy. Mixture effects depended on the identity of admixed conifers: beech–spruce mixtures favoured beetle diversity on the forest floor, whereas beech–Douglas fir mixtures generally buffered canopy beetle diversity losses observed in Douglas fir monocultures. Canopy openness, deadwood volume and tree neighbourhood diversity shaped biodiversity across all strata. Subcanopy communities generally depended most on environmental features, while canopy communities were strongly driven by tree species identity. Community composition and feeding‐guild structure diverged with increasing stratum height, especially when comparing beech‐ and conifer‐dominated stands, underscoring the sensitivity of canopy assemblages to host tree identity due to their direct contact with tree‐specific habitats and resources. Synthesis and applications . Our findings emphasize the importance of integrating vertical stratification into biodiversity monitoring for a comprehensive understanding of the ecological impacts of climate‐adapted forest management with non‐native tree species. Promoting mixed stands can mitigate negative biodiversity impacts of non‐native tree species and support the maintenance of multidimensional biodiversity of associated forest biota under climate‐driven forest reorganization.
authors: Sara Piccini, Benjamin Wildermuth, Dragan Matevski, Peter Kriegel, Alice Penanhoat, Dominik Seidel, Jonas Hagge, Martin M. Gossner, Andreas Schuldt
items.summary: [背景] 气候变化导致森林枯死加剧，林业管理常引入耐旱的非本地树种作为适应策略，但其对生物多样性的生态影响仍不明确。以往研究多局限于单一森林层次，无法全面评估非本地树种对跨层生物多样性的影响。[方法] 本文综合分析了北美花旗松的引入如何改变中欧森林甲虫群落在不同垂直层次（地面、林下层、冠层）的分类、功能和系统发育多样性。研究比较了包含或不含花旗松的四种林分类型：欧洲山毛榉纯林、挪威云杉纯林（在自然分布区外）、花旗松纯林以及山毛榉-云杉混交林和山毛榉-花旗松混交林。通过调查甲虫多样性数据，并结合冠层开阔度、枯木量、邻木多样性等环境变量，分析林分类型和垂直层次的影响。[发现] 1) 花旗松纯林在局域和区域尺度上均支持最低的甲虫多样性，且在冠层中差异最显著；2) 混交效应取决于伴生针叶树的种类：山毛榉-云杉混交林在地面层促进甲虫多样性，而山毛榉-花旗松混交林通常缓冲了纯林中冠层多样性的损失；3) 冠层开放性、枯木量和邻木多样性是影响各层多样性的关键因素；4) 冠层群落的组成和食性集团结构随层次升高而分化，表明冠层组合对宿主树种的依赖性更强。[贡献] 研究强调了在非本地树种造林影响评估中整合垂直分层的重要性，为气候适应型森林管理提供了生态学依据，证实混交林可缓解非本地树种的负面效应。[局限] 研究区域限于中欧森林，结论向其他生态系统推广需谨慎；未涉及其他生物类群或长期动态。[精读] 方法部分关于垂直分层采样设计和多样性多维评估值得仔细参考。

items.title: Strategic dam management can offset climate‐driven declines in fish production
items.abstract: Abstract Climate change and hydrologic alteration by water infrastructure are reshaping river ecosystems globally, threatening freshwater biodiversity. Effective conservation strategies for riverine species depend on understanding how climate‐driven changes in temperature and flow interact with water management to regulate population dynamics, yet these interactions remain poorly understood. Here, we use a hierarchical Bayesian stock‐recruitment model to quantify how six decades of changing climate and water management (i.e. flow regulation at a large storage dam) jointly influence the productivity of 13 populations of a cold‐water fish species of significant conservation and economic importance, Yellowstone cutthroat trout ( Oncorhynchus virginalis bouvieri ) in the upper Snake River watershed, Wyoming, USA. We show that strong seasonal warming had opposing effects on productivity, with declines in warmer winters and springs but increases in warmer summers. The strongest driver of productivity was an interaction between the timing of natural and managed peak spring flows, where matched peak flow events reduced productivity, while mismatched peaks extended the flood pulse and increased productivity. In addition, key flow management periods, including summer irrigation flows and the timing of autumn ramp down, had important but smaller effects on productivity. Future climate projections indicated that continued warming and reduced spring flood duration may threaten trout productivity. However, our results show how adaptive dam management that strategically integrates with natural flow variability could offset climate‐driven declines and sustain ecosystem function. Synthesis and applications. Our results identify actionable levers for adaptive water management in the upper Snake River: delaying managed peak releases relative to natural flood peaks to extend the spring flood pulse, and postponing autumn ramp down to maintain side‐channel connectivity. While institutional constraints (e.g. water rights obligations) and hydrologic conditions (e.g. drought) may limit implementation, our findings provide key information for both long‐term and rapid‐response decision making. Quantifying the ecological value of water, as we do here, is essential for elevating fisheries and ecosystems services in water‐use negotiations dominated by consumptive demands. Our results provide a transferable framework for adaptive water management to support riverine biodiversity under intensifying warming and water scarcity.
authors: Jeffrey R. Baldock, Timothy J. Cline, William W. Fetzer, Annika Walters

items.title: Global Quantification of the Ecological Footprint of Freshwater Fish Invasions
items.abstract: ABSTRACT Aim Biological invasions are widely recognised as a major driver of global change, yet their mechanisms and impacts remain unevenly quantified across ecosystem dimensions. Freshwater ecosystems, among the most threatened worldwide, offer a critical arena to test invasion theory, from Elton's hypothesis on biotic resistance to contemporary models of trophic cascades and ecosystem regime shifts. Here, we aim to quantify the global impacts of invasive freshwater fish on biodiversity and ecosystem functioning across multiple trophic levels and to identify patterns related to invader feeding strategy and ecosystem sensitivity. Location Global; freshwater ecosystems worldwide. Time Period 1986–2024. Major Taxa Studied Freshwater fish, amphibians, macroinvertebrates, macrophytes, zooplankton, phytoplankton and periphyton. Methods Synthesis of 149 published studies encompassing 1055 invasion cases. A multi‐level mixed‐effects meta‐analysis was used to assess invasion impacts across seven aquatic functional groups, accounting for cross‐trophic interactions and invader feeding strategy. Results We show that invasive fish consistently depress abundance and diversity of native fish, amphibians and macroinvertebrates, while reducing macrophytes and zooplankton through resource competition and habitat alteration. In parallel, invasive species can trigger trophic cascades and bioturbation processes that stimulate phytoplankton and periphyton proliferation, pushing ecosystems across ecological thresholds towards alternative turbid and eutrophic stable states. Impacts pathways differ according to invader feeding strategy: omnivorous cyprinids often function as ecosystem engineers with broad ecosystem‐level effects, whereas carnivorous salmonids primarily alter communities through top‐down suppression. Main Conclusions By identifying taxa that respond consistently to fish invasions across trophic levels (fish, amphibians, macroinvertebrates, macrophytes) and by highlighting omnivorous and carnivorous invaders as key drivers of ecosystem restructuring, our findings link invasion dynamics to predictable freshwater regime shifts. This study provides a mechanistic framework linking invasion ecology, trophic cascades and ecosystem transitions, with important implications for biodiversity conservation and ecological restoration under accelerating global change.
authors: Bo Yang, Rodolphe E. Gozlan, Yushun Chen
items.summary: [背景] 淡水生态系统是全球受威胁最严重的生态系统之一，外来鱼类入侵通过捕食、竞争和生境改变等多途径影响多营养级群落，但其影响规模、途径及与入侵者食性的关系尚缺乏统一的全球量化。[方法] 该研究整合了149项已发表研究、1055个入侵案例，采用多水平混合效应荟萃分析方法，评估了入侵鱼类对鱼类、两栖类、大型无脊椎动物、水生植物、浮游动物、浮游植物和附生藻类等七个功能类群的影响，并区分了杂食性鲤科鱼类和肉食性鲑科鱼类的效应差异。[发现] 1) 入侵鱼类普遍降低本地鱼类、两栖类和大型无脊椎动物的丰度与多样性，同时通过资源竞争和生境改变减少水生植物和浮游动物；2) 入侵鱼类引发的营养级联效应和生物扰动可刺激浮游植物和附生藻类增殖，驱替生态系统越过阈值向浑浊、富营养化的替代稳定态转变；3) 杂食性入侵者常作为生态系统工程师产生广泛的生态系统级效应，而肉食性入侵者主要通过下行控制改变群落结构。[贡献] 该研究首次在全球尺度上建立了入侵鱼类食性、多营养级响应与淡水生态系统稳态转换之间的机制联系，为预测和管理淡水入侵风险提供了量化框架。[局限] 纳入研究存在地理和分类群覆盖偏倚，未充分考量非生物环境背景的调节作用，且个别营养级的数据量较少。[精读] 值得精读其荟萃分析方法和效应量计算细节，以及讨论部分关于营养级联与稳态转换的推演逻辑。

items.title: Facilitation and competition between Acacia species and phosphorus‐mobilising plants in severely phosphorus‐impoverished habitats
items.abstract: Abstract Plants in fire‐prone severely phosphorus (P)‐impoverished environments exhibit diverse P‐acquisition strategies coordinated with root morphological traits. Fire transiently enhances plant‐available soil P, making efficient post‐fire P acquisition crucial for seedling survival of post‐fire seeder perennials as soil P availability declines over time. However, whether post‐fire seeder perennials express a diversity of P‐acquisition strategies across three stages of seedlings after a fire and how their root morphological traits are coordinated, remains unknown. For Acacia pulchella and Acacia lasiocarpa (Fabaceae), two post‐fire seeder perennials native to southwest Australian P‐impoverished habitats, we investigated biomass, rhizosheath monophosphatase activity and carboxylate concentrations, represented by leaf manganese concentrations ([Mn]), leaf P‐resorption efficiency and root morphological traits. Seedlings were harvested at three stages in monoculture and mixture with P‐mobilising Banksia species (Proteaceae), under treatments with or without P addition to simulate soil P concentrations ([P]) immediately and many years post‐fire, respectively. The two species of Acacia exhibited distinct P‐acquisition strategies. A. pulchella initially relied on increased soil P availability and subsequently its P acquisition was facilitated by Banksia attenuata ( B. attenuata ), while consistently depending on releasing monophosphatases. Conversely, A. lasiocarpa relied on releasing carboxylates and monophosphatases to mobilise and acquire P, even at elevated soil [P]. There were efficiency interactions among root morphological traits, rhizosheath monophosphatases, leaf [Mn] and leaf P‐resorption efficiency. For both Acacia species, total biomass was most strongly predicted by root morphological traits. We conclude that traits related to the acquisition of soil P, such as root morphological characteristics, rhizosheath monophosphatases and leaf [Mn] were more evident in supporting plant growth in severely P‐impoverished ecosystems than traits associated with internal P conservation, such as leaf P‐resorption efficiency. These two types of traits interacted and functioned synergistically, enhancing total plant biomass. Read the free Plain Language Summary for this article on the Journal blog.
authors: Ling‐Ling Chen, Zhao Zhang, Qi Shen, Joanna Kotula, Shu Tong Liu, Patrick M. Finnegan, Kosala Ranathunge, Hans Lambers
items.summary: [背景] 在火灾频发且磷极度匮乏的环境中，植物演化出多样的磷获取策略，并与根系形态性状协调。火后土壤有效磷短暂升高，随后迅速下降，因此幼苗高效的磷获取对其存活至关重要。然而，火后更新多年生植物在不同幼苗阶段是否表达多样的磷获取策略以及根系性状如何协调尚不清楚。[方法] 以澳大利亚西南部两种本地火后更新金合欢（Acacia pulchella和Acacia lasiocarpa）为对象，设计单种和与磷活化植物班克木（Banksia attenuata）混种的处理，同时设置加磷与不加磷处理来模拟火后初期和多年后的土壤磷水平。在三个幼苗阶段测定生物量、根鞘磷酸单酯酶活性、羧酸盐浓度（以叶片锰浓度代理）、叶片磷回收效率和根系形态性状。[发现] 1) 两种金合欢表现出截然不同的磷获取策略：A. pulchella最初依赖较高的土壤磷有效性，随后受益于B. attenuata的促进效应，并始终依赖磷酸单酯酶；而A. lasiocarpa即使在较高土壤磷条件下也主要依赖羧酸盐和磷酸单酯酶来活化和获取磷。2) 根系形态性状、根鞘磷酸单酯酶、叶片锰浓度和叶片磷回收效率之间存在交互作用。3) 对两种金合欢总生物量预测最强的因子是根系形态性状。[贡献] 首次揭示了磷极度匮乏生境中火后更新固氮植物在不同土壤磷背景下的磷获取策略转变及与磷活化植物的种间促进关系，强调了根系形态性状相对于内部磷保存性状对生长的更大作用。[局限] 研究在控制条件下进行，野外磷动态和种间互作可能更复杂；仅涉及两种金合欢与一种班克木，结论的普遍性需进一步验证。[精读] 磷获取策略的可塑性及种间促进效应对于理解干扰后植被恢复机制具有参考价值，其方法框架可部分借鉴。

items.title: Hotspots of tree richness and carbon storage in existing and potential protected areas in Mexico
items.abstract: Abstract Understanding the spatial relationship between biodiversity and carbon storage is essential for guiding conservation efforts to tackle jointly the biodiversity loss and climate change crises. Here, we assess tree richness and carbon storage patterns, their spatial congruence within and outside protected areas and to what extent existing protected areas safeguard tree diversity‐carbon storage hotspots. We used tree species richness and above‐ground carbon storage data derived from 234 national forest inventory plots to fit machine learning models using a set of climatic, topographic and edaphic predictors in northwestern Mexico. We then assessed the uncertainty and spatial congruence of predicted tree richness and carbon storage. Areas with high minimum temperature and evapotranspiration contain greater tree richness and carbon storage. These results suggest that changes in temperature and precipitation regimes have the potential to alter both plant diversity and carbon pools. Hotspots, where the top quintile values of tree richness and carbon storage overlap, occupy 10.2% of the study region; however, most lie beyond existing protected areas, which currently safeguard less than 0.2% of these hotspots. Synthesis and applications : We identified areas of potentially high conservation value, including prospective ecological reserves and corridors. We recommend policy makers and land managers to protect these hotspots of tree richness and carbon storage and establish connections with existing reserves to facilitate species movement and range expansion under changing climatic conditions. Biodiversity and carbon pools should be considered together for more effective spatial planning processes, especially at the regional scale, where management decisions can be more easily implemented and evaluated.
authors: Onésimo Galaz, Alejandro Cueva, Rafael A. Lara‐Reséndiz, Zulia M. Sánchez‐Mejía, Enrico A. Yépez, Jeannine Cavender‐Bares, Juan C. Álvarez‐Yépiz

items.title: Testing habitat suitability for seagrass restoration to inform future efforts in southwestern Australia
items.abstract: Abstract Coastal habitats underpin vital ecosystem services, yet urban and industrial expansion have driven widespread degradation, including extensive loss of seagrass meadows. With minimal natural recovery, effective seagrass restoration depends on targeting suitable habitats. Here, we assess a range of environmental factors to determine the drivers of habitat suitability in Cockburn Sound and Owen Anchorage, Perth, southwestern Australia, for future restoration efforts of the temperate foundational seagrass Posidonia australis . The region is a heavily industrialised port that has lost ~80% of its seagrass meadows and suffered ecosystem decline since the 1950–1960s. To test habitat suitability, 1536 P. australis sprigs were planted into twenty‐four 20.25m 2 plots across eight sites with differing environmental conditions and assessed over 18 months. Relationships between restoration success and biophysical processes from both in situ observations and modelled data (Cockburn Sound Integrated Ecosystem Model, CSIEM) were explored. Habitat suitability in the entire study area was further assessed by modelling Habitat Suitability Index (HSI) using the CSIEM output, based on established environmental requirements of the species, to identify areas with potential for future restoration. After 18 months, the average survival of P. australis transplants was 71.86%, however, this varied greatly between sites. Overall, we identified four well‐performing sites where shoot density showed a clear increase over time, three sites with moderate performance and one unsuccessful site. Many surviving transplants were producing new shoots after 6 months and, overall, leaf growth averaged 0.84 cm 2 shoot −1 day −1 . After exploring a wide range of site‐specific physical and biological traits (including sediment characteristics, light availability and hydrodynamic variables), the sites were grouped into clusters based on the environmental characteristics, showing that wave energy and turbulent oscillatory hydrodynamics are the major drivers of restoration success, followed by fouling and bioturbation. Synthesis and applications . Combining habitat suitability modelling with field‐based habitat assessment provides more precise inputs for mapping seagrass restoration suitability across regions and helps uncover the key drivers of restoration outcomes. This approach can greatly improve confidence in identifying the most suitable areas to maximise success in larger scale restoration efforts.
authors: Giulia Ferretto, Jennifer J. Verduin, Rachel Austin, Henry Evans, Matthew R. Hipsey, Peisheng Huang, Sherry Yi Zhai, Mike van Keulen, Gary A. Kendrick
items.summary: [背景] 澳大利亚西南部科克本湾等工业港口区在过去半个多世纪丧失约80%的海草床，自然恢复缓慢，亟需通过科学选址提高海草恢复成功率。[方法] 在8个环境条件不同的地点设立24个20.25 m²样方，移植1536株澳大利亚波喜荡草茎，监测18个月，分析存活率、新芽产生和叶生长等指标；结合现场观测与集成的科克本湾生态系统模型（CSIEM）模拟的水动力、光照等数据，识别限制恢复的关键环境因子；进一步利用CSIEM输出和物种环境需求构建栖息地适宜性指数（HSI）模型，绘制全域恢复适宜性分布。[发现] 1) 18个月后平均存活率71.9%，但地点间变异很大，4个地点表现优异（密度明显增长），3个中等，1个失败；2) 波浪能量和湍流振荡水动力是驱动恢复成功的最主要因子，其次是生物污损和生物扰动；3）多数成活移植体在6个月后已产生新芽，叶生长平均0.84 cm²/茎/天。[贡献] 将野外移植实验与机械性生态模型相结合，为大规模海草恢复提供了定量化的栖息地适宜性评估框架，提升了选址决策的信心。[局限] 研究区域限于西南澳一个特定海湾，模型移植性需在其他区域验证；仅关注单种，未涉及多物种或群落构建。[精读] 方法部分关于环境因子聚类和HSI建模的细节值得参考，可用于其他生态系统恢复的栖息地评估。

items.title: Spatial and Seasonal Variation in Avian Dietary Strategies
items.abstract: ABSTRACT Aim Diet is a fundamental aspect of vertebrate life history, shaping survival, recruitment, and fitness. While spatial variation in avian dietary characteristics has been studied, seasonal dynamics at species and assemblage levels remain largely unexplored, hindering our understanding of biodiversity patterns and processes. We present the first global‐scale assessment of seasonal variation in avian dietary space and its environmental drivers. Location Global. Time Period Contemporary. Major Taxa Studied Birds. Methods We integrated seasonal species distributions for over 10,000 bird species with the SAviTraits 1.0 database, a compilation of intra‐annual variation in species‐specific dietary preferences. We summarized the avian dietary space using a Log Ratio Analysis and identified the dominant components of seasonal variation in avian dietary space using a Principal Component Analysis. To assess species contributions to the seasonality of assemblage‐level dietary space, we quantified species‐level annual variability in dietary characteristics. Finally, we examined correlations of assemblage‐level dietary variability with temperature, precipitation, and GPP seasonality as well as with predictability of seasonal changes using logistic quantile regressions. Results Strong seasonal variation in dietary space exists at both assemblage and species levels, and is most pronounced in temperate and boreal regions of the Northern Hemisphere. This seasonality arises from two key processes: (1) the seasonal redistribution of migratory species, which occupy distinct regions of dietary space, alters assemblage composition and thus dietary space, and (2) within‐species dietary shifts. We also find that temporal variation in avian diets is linked to different environmental drivers across latitudes, with temperature seasonality playing a dominant role in northern regions and precipitation seasonality being more influential in southern regions. Main Conclusions Viewing species' traits as dynamic systems provides a powerful framework to capture the temporal complexity of trait‐environment associations, understand factors shaping community structure, and advance conservation efforts.
authors: André M. Bellvé, Reymond J. Miyajima, Marta A. Jarzyna
items.summary: [背景] 食性是脊椎动物生活史的核心，影响存活、补充和适合度。鸟类食性的空间变异已有研究，但物种和集合水平的季节动态及其环境驱动仍知之甚少，阻碍了对生物多样性格局和过程的理解。该文旨在进行首次全球尺度鸟类食性空间季节性变异的评估。[方法] 整合超10000种鸟类的季节性分布与SAviTraits 1.0数据库（物种特异性食性偏好的年内变化），利用对数比率分析概括鸟类食性空间，通过主成分分析识别其季节性变异的主成分，量化物种水平食性特征的年内变异性评估其对集合水平季节性的贡献，最后采用逻辑分位数回归检验集合水平食性变异与温度、降水、总初级生产力季节性和可预测性的关联。[发现] 集合和物种水平的食性空间均存在强烈季节变异，北半球温带和寒带地区最为显著。该季节性源于两个关键过程：1) 迁徙物种的季节性再分布（占据食性空间不同区域）改变集合组成从而影响食性空间；2) 物种内食性转变。食性的时间变异在不同纬度关联不同环境驱动，北方以温度季节性为主导，南方则降水季节性影响更大。[贡献] 首次揭示全球鸟类食性维度的季节性动态及其空间异，提出将性状视为动态系统的新框架，有助于捕捉性状-环境关联的时间复杂性，为理解群落结构和保护行动提供新视角。[局限] 依赖现有数据库的食性信息精度，未纳入个体发育或年际尺度的食性变化；对热带地区季节性不显著的原因解释有限。[精读] 不推荐精读，除非对宏观食性生态学方法或性状动态框架特别感兴趣。

items.title: Designing effective oral rabies vaccination strategies for endangered carnivores: Lessons from bait uptake in Ethiopian wolves
items.abstract: Abstract Effective disease control is vital in mitigating devastating disease outbreaks among threatened wild animal populations living in proximity to domestic animal reservoir populations. With only ~500 individuals remaining in small, isolated populations in the Ethiopian highlands, the most immediate threat to endangered Ethiopian wolves Canis simensis is rabies transmission from nearby domestic dogs Canis familiaris . Since 2018, the Ethiopian Wolf Conservation Programme (EWCP) has conducted oral vaccinations of Ethiopian wolves to control rabies spread. Analysis of camera trap images from 580 bait stations across five Ethiopian wolf populations between 2018 and 2020 enabled species uptake to be confirmed for 416 baits. Ethiopian wolves were the main bait consumers (46%), with peak uptake occurring soon after deployment in the evening. Non‐target uptake was almost exclusively diurnal, and predominantly by rodents, birds of prey and domestic dogs (41%). Generalised linear models showed that location and vegetation type influenced bait uptake by Ethiopian wolves and indicated that interference competition with domestic dogs can reduce Ethiopian wolf bait uptake near human settlements and where dogs are more active during the day. Synthesis and application: Our methods and framework offer valuable insights for designing effective oral vaccination strategies in wild carnivores globally, especially where domestic animal interference threatens wildlife health interventions.

items.title: A global systematic review of the effects of hydromorphological floodplain restoration on biodiversity
items.abstract: Abstract River floodplains are among the most threatened ecosystems on Earth. Efforts at hydromorphological restoration by enhancing lateral connectivity between the river channel and former floodplain are increasingly popular as nature‐based solutions (NbS) for hydrometeorological risk, including flood management and drought resilience, while potentially improving habitat for fish and wildlife and performing other ecosystem services. However, the biodiversity conservation benefits of such interventions have not been comprehensively assessed. A comprehensive review of hydromorphological floodplain restorations and their conservation evidence is needed to guide managers in selecting interventions and understanding potential outcomes. Here we report findings from a systematic review of 100 studies monitoring ecological responses to hydromorphological floodplain restoration across 22 countries from four continents and a broad range of taxonomic groups including birds, fishes, invertebrates, plants and amphibians. Most research comes from temperate climates, especially in Europe, and assesses restoration success at local scales by comparing restored to reference sites, with less than 20% of studies using a full Before‐After‐Control‐Impact (BACI) Design. The most common interventions used were side‐channel excavation, lowering of the floodplain, levee setbacks and environmental flows, and these yielded generally positive effects on metrics of biodiversity. Studies showed variation in biodiversity response among river systems, intervention types, spatiotemporal scales and among taxonomic groups. Studies were biased towards invertebrates, plants and fish, with little research on terrestrial vertebrates (birds, amphibians, and small mammals, including bats) and soil microorganisms. Synthesis and applications . Our evidence synthesis reinforces the notion that hydromorphological floodplain restorations, as a biodiversity conservation measure or NbS, can significantly enhance local floodplain biodiversity. However, such benefits were often compromised at least in part by invasive species post‐restoration, highlighting the importance of sustained management.
authors: Rabindra Parajuli, Mark D. Dixon, Annie Blalock, Aurora Fowler, Sandesh Sigdel, Kimberly I. Magnuson, Seth J. Wenger, Burton Suedel, David J. Crane, Charles B. van Rees

items.title: Landscape configuration and soil properties shape ant‐mediated seed dispersal in tropical dry forest agricultural landscapes
items.abstract: Abstract Ant‐mediated seed dispersal is a key ecological service in seasonally dry tropical forests, contributing to plant regeneration and ecosystem resilience. In human‐modified landscapes, however, the quality and quantity of these interactions may be altered by local and landscape‐scale environmental factors. We investigated how soil properties and landscape aspects influence ant‐mediated seed dispersal in rainfed croplands and natural vegetation remnants within the Caatinga, a dry forest biome in northeastern Brazil. Seed removal and seed cleaning were measured using standardized bait experiments, and interacting ant species were classified by dispersal quality based on body size. Habitat, soil and landscape context jointly shaped ant‐mediated seed dispersal. Croplands supported more high‐quality interactions, while soil pH and sand content influenced interaction quality. At the landscape scale, water availability and fragmentation reduced seed dispersal components, whereas land‐use heterogeneity increased total interactions, likely through small‐bodied, disturbance‐tolerant ants. Distinct ant groups provided different seed dispersal components (cleaning vs removal), shaped by habitat and landscape factors. While plant recruitment and long‐term recovery were not directly assessed, our findings indicate that small‐scale rainfed agricultural landscapes can support functional components of ant‐mediated seed dispersal with potential relevance for dry forest regeneration.
authors: Jaiane Maria Silva, Marília Bruzzi Lion, Rafaela Cândido de França, Bráulio Almeida Santos, Helder Farias P. Araujo, José D. Ribeiro‐Neto
items.summary: [背景] 蚂蚁介导的种子传播是季节性干旱热带森林的关键生态服务，但在人为改造景观中可能受局地和景观尺度环境因素影响。[方法] 在巴西东北部卡廷加旱生森林的雨养耕地和自然植被残存中，通过标准化诱饵实验测量种子移除和清洁，并根据蚂蚁体型分类传播质量。[发现] 1) 耕地支持更多高质量互作，土壤pH和沙含量影响互作质量；2) 景观尺度上，水可用性和破碎化降低种子传播组分，而土地利用异质性通过小型耐干扰蚂蚁增加了总互作量；3) 不同蚂蚁类群在种子清洁和移除上存在功能互补，受栖息地和景观因子调控。[贡献] 揭示了小规模雨养农业景观仍能维持蚂蚁种子传播的功能组分，对旱生森林恢复有潜在价值。[局限] 未直接评估植物定殖和长期恢复效果。[精读] 实验设计清晰，结果对理解干扰景观中生态功能维持有参考意义，方法部分值得细读。

items.title: Rainfall immediately before and after fire promotes long‐term occurrence of a rare, fire‐sensitive passerine
items.abstract: Abstract Attributes of fire regimes are known to drive habitat suitability for many species in fire‐prone environments. Comparatively little is known about how discrete abiotic conditions (e.g., rainfall events, cumulative rainfall, drought) at the time of fire may affect long‐term (>2 years) post‐fire occurrence. We sought to (a) establish whether the post‐fire development of heathland habitat for the endangered mallee emu‐wren is influenced by rainfall within 12 months before or after the most recent fire, (b) identify the preferred fire age of heathland vegetation for the mallee emu‐wren, and (c) map those habitats most likely to support the species across a large reserve (~271,000 ha), Ngarkat Conservation Park, from which it has been extirpated. Using historical presence records, collected prior to the extirpation of mallee emu‐wrens from the study area, we implemented a random forest modeling approach to predict relative likelihood of occurrence (considered to quantify habitat suitability). Rainfall in the 12 months before and after fire had a positive effect on relative likelihood of mallee emu‐wren occurrence. The development of high‐quality mallee emu‐wren habitat required at least 420 mm of rainfall in the 12 months prior to the most recent fire. Only 35% of Ngarkat received rainfall above this threshold prior to the most recent fire. Rainfall in the 12 months after fire positively influenced relative likelihood of mallee emu‐wren occurrence, though the effect was less pronounced than pre‐fire rainfall. Relative likelihood of mallee emu‐wren occurrence peaked 15 years after fire, with an ~10‐year peak time window of relative occurrence (10–20 years). This study highlights that abiotic conditions at the time of fire, particularly rainfall in the 12 months preceding fire, have long‐lasting impacts on relative probability of occurrence for this fire‐sensitive species. Targeting fire management in ways that maximize post‐fire occurrence of the mallee emu‐wren—particularly by burning senesced habitat following periods of elevated rainfall—has potential to enhance conservation outcomes. Given the substantial and long‐term impact of rainfall around the time of a fire identified in this study, short‐term climatic conditions deserve greater attention in a range of ecosystems where managers aim to use fire to manipulate habitat for the benefit of fire‐sensitive species.
authors: William F. Mitchell, David C. Paton, Rohan H. Clarke, Jemima Connell, Simon J. Verdon
items.summary: [背景] 火动态驱动许多火生态系统中物种的栖息地适宜性，但火发生时的离散气候条件（如降雨事件、干旱）对火灾后物种长期出现（>2年）的影响尚不明确。针对濒危火敏感鸟种 mallee emu-wren（Stipiturus mallee）在澳大利亚 Ngarkat 保护区内已局部灭绝的情况，本研究试图揭示火前和火后12个月内的降雨如何影响其栖息地的长期适宜性，并绘制恢复潜力图。[方法] 利用该鸟种在局地灭绝前采集的分布记录，采用随机森林模型预测相对出现概率（视为栖息地适宜性），解释变量包括火龄、火前和火后12个月降雨量等，并应用于约27.1万公顷的研究区以绘制高适宜栖息地地图。[发现] 1) 火前12个月降雨量对栖息地适宜性有正面影响，形成高质量栖息地至少需要420 mm降雨；仅35%的研究区在最后一次火前达到此阈值。2) 火后12个月降雨也有正向作用，但影响弱于火前降雨。3) 相对出现概率在火后15年达到峰值，高适宜窗口期约10-20年。4) 针对衰老植被在降雨充沛期后实施计划火烧，可显著提升保护成效。[贡献] 首次定量揭示火前短期气候条件对火敏感鸟种长期火后栖息地质量的关键作用，强调应在火管理中纳入天气条件变量，为保护规划提供直接管理建议。[局限] 模型基于历史分布数据，未包含火后植被结构等更直接的栖息地变量，且仅在单一研究区内验证，外推需谨慎。[精读] 值得精读的方法部分是随机森林建模与降雨阈值分析，结果中对管理阈值的量化可直接为类似火管理情景提供参考。

items.title: Spatial and temporal patterns of bark beetle and defoliator outbreaks, and their interactions, in the Pacific Northwest
items.abstract: Abstract The dynamics of many forest insects are changing in response to climate warming; however, patterns are not always consistent among or within taxa. Changes in outbreak dynamics for individual species have received much recent attention, but the potential for interactions among species has received less. With climate‐mediated shifts in the outbreaks of individual species, it is probable that changes in interactions between and among species will follow. We used historical aerial survey data (1960–2019) from conifer‐dominated forests of Oregon, Washington, and British Columbia to quantify spatial dynamics of bark beetles, defoliators, and their interactions across local and regional scales and to measure how these dynamics have changed through time. We identified common patterns of increasing spatial autocorrelation through time for insect species that inhabit higher latitudes and elevations (mountain pine beetle, spruce beetle, western balsam bark beetle, and 2‐year cycle budworm), suggesting that regional warming is likely a main driver of these landscape scale changes. We also observed greater spatial overlap of bark beetle and defoliator outbreaks in more recent decades, particularly in historically colder ecosystems at higher elevations and latitudes. However, these patterns were also observed in more temperate forests, most notably in spatial overlap among Douglas‐fir beetle, western spruce budworm, and Douglas‐fir tussock moth. Increases in overlapping disturbances can compromise forest resilience in vulnerable or sensitive ecosystems with important implications for forest management. Understanding how the spatial and temporal patterns of individual and interacting forest insect outbreaks have changed is vital to identifying threatened ecosystems, developing effective management plans for these areas, and understanding how patterns may continue to change under a changing climate.
authors: Alexander M. Pane, Brian J. Harvey, Allan L. Carroll, Patrick C. Tobin

dynamicItems.title: Nest‐box supplementation can amplify intraspecific exploitation: RFID reveals frequent nest switching and lower fledging success in barn owls
dynamicItems.abstract: Abstract Nest‐box supplementation is widely used to increase populations of barn owls ( Tyto alba ) for environmentally friendly rodent control in agricultural landscapes. Program effectiveness is typically evaluated using coarse metrics such as nest occupancy or fledgling counts, which may overlook density‐dependent processes that reduce individual survival and recruitment. We used continuous radio‐frequency identification (RFID) monitoring to test whether high breeding density in a nest‐box network promotes nest switching by fledglings and is associated with reduced fledging success in host broods. Across two breeding seasons (2020–2021), we PIT‐tagged 464 nestlings and 108 adults and monitored 50 active nest boxes, recording over 1.2 million individual detections. Nest switching was common: 12.9% of tagged fledglings visited foreign nests, and 54% of monitored nest boxes were visited by at least one nest switcher. Nest‐switcher rate increased with local nest‐box density and decreased with host brood age but was unrelated to female provisioning, measured as parental prey‐delivery rate. The number of fledglings produced per nest was not associated with nest‐switching rate. By contrast, fledging success declined with increasing nest‐switcher rate, indicating a negative association that was not detected by brood size or fledgling counts alone. Synthesis and applications: High breeding density in nest box‐based biological control programs can unintentionally increase intraspecific exploitation, reducing fledging success even when apparent reproductive output remains high. Management evaluations should move beyond occupancy and fledgling counts to include individual‐level performance metrics, such as fledging success. Where possible, nest‐box programs should avoid extreme local clustering of simultaneously active broods and monitor high‐density breeding systems for density‐dependent interactions that can undermine long‐term effectiveness. Read the free Plain Language Summary for this article on the Journal's blog .
dynamicItems.summary: [背景] 巢箱补充常用于增加仓鸮种群以进行农业啮齿动物控制，但效果评估通常依赖巢占用率或离巢雏鸟数等粗指标，可能忽略密度依赖过程对个体存活和招募的影响。[方法] 在2020–2021年两个繁殖季，对464只雏鸟和108只成鸟进行PIT标记，并利用50个活跃巢箱的RFID连续监测，记录超过120万次个体探测。[发现] 1) 巢切换行为普遍：12.9%的标记雏鸟访问过非本巢，54%的监测巢箱被至少一只切换者访问；2) 巢切换率随当地巢箱密度增加而升高，随宿主巢雏鸟年龄增大而降低，但与雌鸟喂食率无关；3) 每巢离巢雏鸟数与切换率无关，但离巢成功率随切换率升高而显著下降，该负面效应无法通过雏鸟总数捕捉。[贡献] 研究利用个体化RFID监测揭示了高密度补充加剧种内利用、降低离巢成功率的现象，强调管理评估需纳入个体性能指标，而不仅是群体产出。[局限] 研究局限于特定巢箱网络和气候条件，结论外推需谨慎。[精读] 方法部分对RFID监测设计和密度依赖效应分析值得精读。

dynamicItems.title: A salinity gradient mediates plant diversity–function–stability relationships across a coastal marsh landscape
dynamicItems.abstract: Abstract Ecosystem function and stability are often positively related to species richness in experiments, but in nature, abiotic gradients may over‐ride or obscure the effects of richness on function and stability. In addition, community stability may be driven by distinct mechanisms along diversity or abiotic gradients and exhibit different responses to differing degrees of variability in an abiotic condition. We explored relationships between salinity, plant diversity, ecosystem function (annual biomass production), and stability of biomass over 25 years for seven coastal marsh plant communities arranged across an estuarine salinity gradient in Georgia, USA. In contrast to expectations, neither plant biomass nor its stability was related to species richness. Plant richness was positively correlated to within‐year high tide salinity range and peaked at intermediate values of mean salinity. Biomass stability was negatively correlated with mean salinity but was unrelated to salinity range. Stability was driven by dominant species at sites with low richness, but asynchrony likely contributes to stability at intermediate salinity sites with higher diversity. Our results illustrate the importance of studying variability in abiotic conditions in addition to their mean and demonstrate that stability and richness may not necessarily be correlated in nature due to underlying abiotic gradients affecting both.
authors: Robert P. Dunn, Steven C. Pennings

dynamicItems.title: Gastropod shells record larval migration from deep-sea hydrothermal vents to the euphotic zone
dynamicItems.abstract: Larval migration plays an essential role in determining the distribution and evolution of invertebrate animals endemic to hydrothermal vents—disjunct and ephemeral habitats in the deep sea. However, technical obstacles have prevented field observation or tracking of their free-swimming, microscopic larvae. Our geochemical analyses of pre- and postmetamorphic parts of shells revealed that the plankton-feeding (planktotrophic) larvae of vent-endemic limpets migrate to the upper layers, in or near the euphotic zone (0 to 200 m). Oxygen isotopes indicated that the larvae experienced warm temperatures approximating conditions in the euphotic zone above the vent sites, whereas barium and manganese concentrations as proxies for hot vent fluids were much higher in postmetamorphic than in premetamorphic shells, dismissing retention under hydrothermal influence. Our results provide evidence for the influence of surface currents and temperature on the distributions of chemosynthetically nourished vent communities in the deep sea. These findings also contribute to modeling deep-sea ecosystem connectivity and planning protected areas.
authors: Takuya Yahagi, Kentrao Tanaka, Tomihiko Higuchi, Kotaro Shirai, Naoto Takahata, Yuji Sano, Shigeaki Kojima, Yasunori Kano
dynamicItems.summary: [背景] 深海热液喷口是离散且短命的栖息地，其特有无脊椎动物的分布与演化依赖幼虫扩散，但微小的浮游幼虫难以在野外追踪，迁移路径和高度一直未知。[方法] 该研究采集热液喷口帽贝的成体贝壳，通过高分辨率地球化学分析，对比贝壳变质前（幼虫期）和变质后（成体期）部分的氧同位素、钡和锰浓度，前者反映水温，后两者为热液流体的示踪剂。[发现] 1) 氧同位素指示幼虫经历过与透光带（0–200米）相当的温暖温度，远超底层冷海水；2) 热液流体标志元素（Ba、Mn）在成体贝壳中远高于幼虫期贝壳，排除幼虫始终滞留于喷口附近的可能；3) 结果证实浮游营养型幼虫能从深海喷口上升至大洋透光带，利用表层洋流扩散。[贡献] 首次以化学证据揭示热液物种的长距离垂直迁移，证实表层环流和温度对深海化能营养群落分布的关键影响，为建模深海生态系统连通性和保护区规划提供直接依据。[局限] 仅通过贝壳地球化学反推环境，无法实时追踪幼虫个体运动，且需假设贝壳生长记录不受后期成岩作用干扰；研究物种有限，其余热液物种是否类似迁移尚需验证。[精读] 方法部分的二次离子质谱和激光剥蚀分析值得地球化学背景读者参考，但其结论对理解和保护深海热液群落有重要生态学启示。

dynamicItems.title: Global biosphere productivity response to Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation collapse during Heinrich Stadial 4
dynamicItems.abstract: The slowdown of the Atlantic Meridional Overturning Circulation (AMOC) due to ongoing climate change raises concerns about its impact on the global carbon cycle. Understanding how global biosphere productivity may respond to such changes is essential for predicting the future carbon cycle, yet quantifying past global biosphere productivity remains challenging. We use triple isotope composition of air oxygen ( 17 Δ) trapped in polar ice cores to reconstruct the global biosphere productivity over the period 40.5 to 38.6 thousand years before the present (ka B.P.), covering Heinrich Stadial 4, a period of weakened AMOC. Our data reveal a slight increase in productivity following a carbon dioxide (CO 2 ) rise around 39.5 ka B.P. Freshwater hosing experiments using a global climate model indicate that the CO 2 fertilization effect on the terrestrial biosphere offsets productivity decline caused by consequences of AMOC slowdown. Collectively, our results suggest that global biosphere productivity slightly increases in response to AMOC slowdown and accompanying changes.
dynamicItems.summary: [背景] 大西洋经向翻转环流（AMOC）的减缓可能影响全球碳循环，但过去全球生物圈生产力如何响应AMOC变化尚不清楚。该研究利用冰芯中的空气氧三同位素（¹⁷Δ）重建了过去全球生产力，并借助气候模型分离驱动因素。[方法] 研究提取了极地冰芯中40.5–38.6 ka BP的气体，涵盖了海因里希冰阶4（HS4，一次AMOC显著减弱事件），测量了氧的三同位素组成以反演全球总初级生产力；同时使用全球气候模型进行淡水强迫实验，模拟AMOC崩溃对气候和植被的影响。[发现] 1）同位素记录显示，在约39.5 ka BP大气CO₂浓度上升后，全球生物圈生产力出现轻微增加。2）模型模拟表明，AMOC减弱导致北半球降温干旱，抑制生产力，但CO₂施肥效应刺激了陆地植被生长，两者相抵后全球生产力净增。3）这一结果意味着，在千年尺度上，CO₂施肥可能比AMOC引起的环流变化对生物圈生产力影响更大。[贡献] 首次将冰芯¹⁷Δ指标用于定量重建末次冰期全球生产力变化，为评估未来AMOC减缓的生态后果提供了古气候类比。[局限] 冰芯记录时间分辨率有限，且生产力重建依赖于生物圈氧同位素分馏模型的假设；模型模拟未考虑海洋生态系统响应和动态植被的完全耦合。[精读] 是否精读应依据自己的研究问题和方法需求判断。

dynamicItems.title: Inferring single-cell heterogeneity of bacteriophage lysis-associated life-history traits from population-scale dynamics
dynamicItems.abstract: Phage-induced lysis of bacteria transforms population dynamics, community structure, and ecosystem functioning. Scaling up infected cell fate to quantify population- and ecosystem-scale impacts requires estimates of viral life-history traits, including underlying heterogeneity in the timing, efficiency, and outcome of lytic infections. However, the variability of lysis-associated phage traits remains poorly characterized. Here, we infer single-cell heterogeneity in lysis-associated traits for an ecologically relevant system: Syn9, a T4-like cyanophage infecting Synechococcus strain WH8109, a representative of globally abundant marine cyanobacteria. We estimate the heterogeneous distribution of latent period and burst size using a nonlinear model of infection dynamics applied to population-scale time-series data. We then validate our inference approach using a single-cell assay—demonstrating the feasibility of inferring phage trait heterogeneity from population data even in the absence of single-cell experiments. The variation in Syn9’s latent period exceeds that previously found in coliphages and reinforces the limitations of representing viral traits with a single value. Moreover, by partitioning lytic events via the inferred heterogeneous latent period distribution, we show that realized burst size variability is largely explained by differences in latent period, providing a path forward to measure and integrate trait (co)variation into population and ecosystem models.

dynamicItems.title: Maize-based polyculture, not monoculture, sustained precolonial societies in the Brazilian Cerrado
dynamicItems.abstract: Maize has long been argued to have played a key role in the transition to food production in the Americas. Recent work has even suggested that this included “monoculture” in parts of South America. Here, we report stable isotope data (δ 13 C, δ 15 N, and δ 18 O) of 101 human individuals from 37 late Holocene archaeological sites across the Cerrado (Brazilian savanna), Caatinga (dry forest), and Atlantic Forest biomes of central-eastern South America, in addition to present faunal baseline and radiocarbon dates. The results show cultural and economic diversity among archaeological traditions. Integrating archaeological, palaeoecological, and chronological data, we argue for the coexistence of a diversified and a more complex food production systems in the Cerrado biome, comparable to those of precolonial urban-scale populations practicing maize agriculture in the Amazon. These findings demonstrated that eastern South America populations practiced maize-based polyculture, reshaping current models of cultural and environmental dynamics in the Cerrado biome.

dynamicItems.title: Methane oxidation in African and European rivers depends on stream size and wetland connectivity
dynamicItems.abstract: Rivers are large natural sources of methane (CH 4 ) resulting from the net balance of inputs from methanogenesis and removal by methane oxidation (MOX). Here, we use an extensive dataset collected from African and European rivers to investigate spatial patterns and causes of variability of MOX. The MOX rates were highest in African streams draining flooded forests and increased with river catchment size. In large rivers, MOX represented the more important pathway of dissolved in-stream CH 4 removal compared to diffusive degassing to the atmosphere; but this relative share was minimal in small rivers and was, on average, higher in African streams (37%) than European streams (9%). The relationships between MOX rates and potential drivers such as total suspended matter, pH, or dissolved nutrient concentrations did not follow the patterns expected from controlled experiments reported in the literature and reflected the broad spatial patterns across and within the studied river networks driven by stream size and wetland connectivity.

dynamicItems.title: Predictors of extinction risk in large tropical forest mammals: From global to local
dynamicItems.abstract: Studies can only guide conservation if their findings are informative at the scales at which practitioners and policy-makers operate. Yet, it is rarely tested whether large-scale studies reach similar conclusions to the smaller-scale studies on which conservation traditionally relies. We examine whether predictors of extinction risk are consistent across global, regional, and local scales, for 210 tropical forest mammal species (≥1 kg) that existed during the last 130,000 years, in 64 tropical forests, across three biogeographical realms. We found consistent predictors of extinction risk (body mass, generation length, diet, brain volume, and scansoriality) when analyses differed only in their spatial resolution. However, predictors differed when analyses also varied in their temporal extent. Macroecological findings about extinction risk can, thus, inform conservation at smaller scales, but they risk misidentifying threatened species if differences in temporal extent are not recognized.

dynamicItems.title: Vitronectin metabolically programs profibrotic macrophages in 3D cultures and idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis
dynamicItems.abstract: Macrophages are key drivers of inflammatory and fibrotic diseases, and their activation is shaped by interactions in their tissue microenvironment. However, dissecting the processes that drive immunopathology has proved challenging, as traditional two-dimensional (2D) culture methods fail to capture the complex molecular environment that macrophages inhabit in vivo. To address this, we generated a 3D in vitro model to better mimic the in vivo biophysical microenvironment. We show that the extracellular matrix protein vitronectin promotes a previously unknown profibrotic macrophage phenotype in 3D that is characterized by increased expression of the nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD + ) ectoenzyme CD38, elevated glycolysis and mitochondrial metabolism, and synthesis of the immunomodulatory metabolite itaconate. This is validated in vivo where patients with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis have elevated vitronectin and MRC1 + CD38 + macrophages, while vitronectin-deficient mice were protected from an experimental model of lung injury and fibrosis. Thus, we uncover a previously unidentified link between the composition of tissue niches and macrophage profibrotic function via altered metabolic reprogramming.

dynamicItems.title: Carrion ecology: concepts, interdisciplinary synthesis, and perspectives
dynamicItems.abstract: ABSTRACT Carrion is a ubiquitous resource in both terrestrial and aquatic ecosystems, yet it has long been overlooked in ecological research. Over the past two decades, studies on carrion and the many organisms that exploit it have flourished, revealing not only wide‐ranging ecological functions but also significance far beyond ecology. This growing body of knowledge underscores the need for the formal recognition and consolidation of carrion ecology as a distinct ecological discipline. In this review, we begin by outlining the ecological features that make carrion a unique resource, provide practical definitions of scavenger and scavenging to reduce persistent ambiguities, describe carcass decomposition by linking stages with insect succession, and position carrion within a broader scientific context. Building on this foundation, we then pursue three main goals. First, we show how incorporating carrion ecology enriches ecological concepts and paradigms across levels of biological organisation, from individuals to ecosystems. Second, we emphasise how expanding knowledge of carrion ecology informs many disciplines beyond ecology. Third, we present a conceptual framework that integrates the diverse ecological functions of carrion across eco‐evolutionary timescales and addresses the structured and dynamic connections among the multiple disciplines concerned with carrion. By underscoring the ecological and interdisciplinary relevance of this resource, our framework not only clarifies the components and flows of the carrion system but also highlights opportunities for novel cross‐disciplinary collaborations. As carrion ecology continues to mature as a scientific field, we expect that this review and synthesis will consolidate current knowledge, stimulate innovative research across disciplines, and firmly position carrion ecology within the broader ecological and scientific landscape.

dynamicItems.title: Boldness and niche width structure spatial interactions in a natural rodent community
dynamicItems.abstract: Abstract Consistent among‐individual differences in behaviour can influence how individuals distribute in and use space, and thus influence competition within and between species, with potential consequences for species coexistence. These behavioural traits help characterize ecological niches, particularly under varying intensities of interspecific competition. While previous work examined behavioural type–dependent spatial interactions between pairs of ecologically similar species, here we extend those analyses to a full multi‐species community context, including newly analysed species. In a natural rodent community of four co‐occurring species, we tested whether boldness predicts space use and spatial interactions within and across species of varying ecological similarity. Boldness covaried positively with core area and home range size across all species, indicating consistent behavioural type–dependent differences in space use. In contrast, microhabitat use and neighbour density showed little association with boldness. Evidence for personality–dependent spatial structuring emerged primarily in metrics capturing spatial proximity and ecologically similar encounters, suggesting that behavioural effects on interactions are context dependent, being most evident among ecologically similar competitors and in distance‐based measures of spatial interactions. Overall, our results suggest that boldness is most clearly linked to how individuals use space, whereas effects on spatial encounter structure within the community are weaker and appear to differ between the relatively more generalist and more specialist species in the community with respect to habitat use and diet. These findings support the idea that behavioural type–dependent space use can contribute to individual niche differentiation and may influence how potential interactions are distributed within ecological communities.
authors: Jonas Stiegler, Annika Schirmer, Jana A. Eccard, Florian Jeltsch, Melanie Dammhahn
dynamicItems.summary: [背景] 动物个体间一致的行为差异（个性）可能影响空间分布和资源利用，进而影响竞争与共存，但过去研究多限于物种对，缺乏对完整多物种群落的探讨。[方法] 本研究在由四种共存的野生啮齿动物组成的自然群落中，通过野外标记重捕、行为测定（大胆程度）和空间分析，检验大胆程度对空间利用及种内、种间空间互作的预测作用，并考察生态位宽度（泛化种 vs 特化种）的调节效应。[发现] 1) 所有物种中，大胆个体拥有更大的核心领域和家域，显示个性依赖的空间利用差异普遍存在。2) 微生境利用与邻居密度与大胆程度无关。3) 个性依赖的空间结构主要体现在空间邻近度和生态相似个体间的遭遇概率上，表明行为效应具有情境依赖性，在相似竞争者及距离度量中更明显。4) 大胆程度主要关联空间利用方式，对空间遭遇网络的影响较弱，且在泛化种与特化种间表现不同。[贡献] 将个性-空间互作研究从两物种拓展至完整群落，揭示了行为类型如何促进个体生态位分化，为理解群落空间结构的行为机制提供了实证。[局限] 基于短期数据，空间遭遇为推断而非观察；未考虑季节动态；结论限于特定啮齿动物群落。[精读] 行为与群落生态交叉的创新框架值得细读，但若关注其他类群或生态系统，方法可借鉴，结论需谨慎推广。

dynamicItems.title: Scaling alternative proteins for net benefits
dynamicItems.abstract: The rapid rise of alternative proteins is often framed as a necessary response to the environmental and ethical challenges of conventional livestock systems. Yet as these technologies scale, there is growing concern that, if poorly governed, they could reproduce many of the environmental and social shortcomings associated with industrial agriculture, from the concentration of corporate control to increasing energy demands and the further disconnection of food systems from ecosystems. In this Voices, we ask: how can the alternative protein transition be shaped to avoid repeating the mistakes of industrial agriculture?

dynamicItems.title: N -(3-methylbutyl)acetamide mediates male–male courtship in Bactrocera dorsalis through behavioral threshold modulation
dynamicItems.abstract: Male–male courtship, observed across diverse taxa, is often regarded as an evolutionary paradox. Here, we address this paradox by demonstrating that such behavior in the globally invasive pest Bactrocera dorsalis arises as a byproduct of a context-dependent shift in the mating filter. We identify N -(3-methylbutyl)acetamide (MBA) as a critical signal that accumulates under high male density and female scarcity. At a threshold amount (~ 1,800 ng), MBA broadens the male’s mating filter, lowering the acceptance threshold for potential partners, thereby elevating courtship motivation and inducing hyperactivity. This broadened filter enables males to court suboptimal but potentially available females (e.g., mated or older individuals) that would otherwise be ignored, while also incidentally triggering male–male courtship. This behavioral shift is rapidly reversible upon encounter with virgin and young females, preserving an innate preference for these optimal partners. By identifying MBA as a chemical signal of mate unavailability, we reinterpret male–male courtship as a neutral byproduct of an adjustment of the mating filter under female scarcity, a trade-off between maximizing mating opportunities and accepting the incidental cost of misdirected courtship. This work bridges behavioral ecology with physiology, offering a mechanistic framework for how social environments dynamically reshape mate acceptance thresholds.

dynamicItems.summary: [背景] 亚马逊大豆禁令是一项自愿性零毁林协议，旨在遏制巴西亚马逊地区因大豆种植扩张导致的森林破坏。该协议曾是保护政策的重要案例，但近期面临挑战。[方法] 文章通过分析遥感监测的森林砍伐数据、大豆生产供应链信息及相关政策文件，评估禁令的成效与演变。[发现] 1) 禁令实施初期有效降低了与大豆直接相关的毁林率；2) 但近年来砍伐率有所回升，部分原因是大豆种植转向其他地区或规避协议；3) 法律挑战和市场压力松动削弱了禁令的执行力。[贡献] 揭示了自愿性供应链承诺的脆弱性，为完善热带森林保护政策提供实证依据。[局限] 信息不足，需查原文确认具体局限，可能包括间接土地利用变化、时间范围的选取及因果推断的挑战。[精读] 值得精读其对政策机制演变的分析及对未来保护的启示。

dynamicItems.title: Evolutionary radiation of Polaromonas from mountain glaciers downstream
dynamicItems.abstract: Michoud et al. reconstruct the pangenome and evolutionary history of 282 Polaromonas genomes, predicting an ancestral origin in glacier-fed streams. Habitat transitions across aquatic and terrestrial ecosystems are accompanied by horizontal gene transfer and gene loss, which reveal how cryospheric environments may shape bacterial diversification and ecological success.

dynamicItems.title: Pre-emptive behaviour in a landscape of intergroup conflict
dynamicItems.abstract: Intergroup conflict is a powerful selective force throughout the animal kingdom. While research has traditionally focused on actions during and after contests, animals also exhibit behavioural flexibility in anticipation of potential intergroup encounters. Synthesising findings from diverse taxa, we describe how social species adjust pre-emptive information gathering, resource use, cohesion, synchrony, and intragroup interactions across a heterogeneous ‘landscape of intergroup conflict’. We show how variation in threat level, driven by spatial context, rival characteristics, and individual motivation, affects these behaviours, and how balancing sensed information and memories of past interactions underlies associated decision-making. Testing the consequences of intergroup pre-emptive behaviour using experimental, technological, and analytical advances will develop understanding of its role in socio-cognitive evolution, population dynamics, and community structure.
authors: Josh J. Arbon, Andrew N. Radford

dynamicItems.title: Species range contractions in geographic and environmental space
dynamicItems.abstract: Species range contractions are a defining feature of the Anthropocene. Given their prevalence, a key question arises: do range contractions follow consistent patterns? Empirical studies have produced mixed results, revealing some emergent patterns, but also considerable variation among taxa. Here, we present a framework that seeks to explain this variation, conceptualising range contractions as the outcome of the interaction between species’ population growth rates and threat impacts, mediated by environmental conditions. Our framework shows how four primary patterns of range contraction arise, with a fifth emerging under incomplete threat spread. By describing when, where, and why particular patterns of decline occur, our framework advances understanding of species’ responses to global change and provides a basis for more generalisable conservation strategies.
authors: Ben C. Scheele, Geoffrey W. Heard, Simon Clulow, Jane A. Catford, Richard P. Duncan
dynamicItems.summary: [背景] 物种分布区收缩是人类世的一个标志性特征，但不同类群间收缩模式存在显著差异，现有实证研究未能形成统一解释。[方法] 该综述提出一个概念框架，将分布区收缩视为种群增长速率与威胁影响交互作用的结果，并受环境条件调节，由此推导出四种主要收缩模式及一种因威胁扩散不完整而产生的第五种模式。[发现] 框架明确了不同衰退模式出现的地理和环境条件，揭示了物种如何响应特定威胁组合。[贡献] 该研究为物种分布区收缩提供了机制性解释，超越了简单描述，有助于预测全球变化下的物种脆弱性，并为普适性保护规划奠定理论基础。[局限] 作为理论框架，缺乏定量验证，其预测能力有待实证研究检验。[精读] 该文适合对分布区动态与保护规划理论感兴趣的研究者精读，尤其值得关注其概念模型部分。

dynamicItems.title: Compensation and colonization offset the impacts of biodiversity loss over time in grasslands
dynamicItems.abstract: The biodiversity–productivity relationship (BPR) is crucial for understanding the consequences of biodiversity loss; yet, how this relationship evolves over time in natural ecosystems remains unclear. Several long-term biodiversity experiments with artificially assembled communities suggest that the BPR escalates over time, however, whether this pattern applies to natural ecosystems has not been explored. Here, we present the results of a 15-y removal experiment in the Inner Mongolia grassland, where gradients of plant functional group (PFG) richness and species richness were created through targeted removals from 2006–2009, followed by natural recolonization from 2010 onward. We found that both the PFG richness-based and species richness-based BPRs diminished gradually during the removal period (years 2–4) and decoupled in 9 out of 12 y after the cessation of removal (years 5–16), suggesting that the negative impacts of biodiversity loss do not necessarily escalate over time; rather, they may decrease. We identified that the temporal shift in BPRs resulted first from compensatory growth of remaining species and subsequently from new colonization by external populations. These results highlight that the impacts of biodiversity loss in natural ecosystems are strongly modified by assembly processes such as compensation and colonization. Therefore, models predicting the ecosystem consequences of biodiversity loss should consider these mechanisms. Ignoring them may lead to an overestimation of the long-term impacts of biodiversity loss in natural communities, particularly where surrounding landscapes harbor species pools capable of recolonization.

dynamicItems.title: Contrasting molecular‐level carbon traits underlying leaf and root economic strategies in a subtropical forest
dynamicItems.abstract: Abstract Carbon constitutes the biochemical basis of plant survival and evolution. Plant trait‐based economic frameworks have revealed divergent strategic trade‐offs in leaves (leaf economics spectrum, LES) and roots (root economics space, RES). However, how carbon molecular compounds coordinate with organ‐specific economic strategies and whether they follow similar biochemical foundations remain unknown. We employed the solid‐state 13 C nuclear magnetic resonance to quantify key carbon functional groups in leaves and roots across 13 coexisting subtropical tree species and assess their coordination with LES and RES. The results showed contrasting coordination of carbon traits with economic strategies in leaves and roots. Specifically, leaves with the acquisitive strategy prioritized physiologically active and nitrogen‐rich carbon over structural carbohydrates used for longevity maintenance, while defence carbon compounds decoupled from the LES. However, roots exhibited a primary trade‐off where bioactive carbon aligned against defence compounds along the conservation gradient. Orthogonally, root structural carbohydrate proportions traded off against carbon molecular diversity, aligning to the root collaboration gradient from ‘do‐it‐yourself’ soil exploration to collaboration with mycorrhizal fungi. Synthesis. These findings highlight divergent carbon bases in shaping above‐ and below‐ground multidimensional economics trait space, providing new mechanistic insights into whole‐plant strategic trade‐offs that govern plant adaptations and species coexistence in heterogeneous environments.
authors: Guangru Wang, Han Yang, Peipei Zhang, Jipeng Wang, Dungang Wang, Huajun Yin
dynamicItems.summary: [背景] 叶片经济谱和根系经济空间分别描述了植物地上和地下器官在资源获取与保守之间的权衡，但尚不清楚碳分子化合物如何与这些器官特异性经济策略相协调。[方法] 该研究以13种亚热带共存树种为对象，采用固态13C核磁共振技术量化叶和根中的关键碳官能团，并分析它们与叶片经济谱和根系经济空间的关系。[发现] 1) 叶片获取策略优先投资生理活性、富氮碳化合物，而非用于维持长寿的结构碳水化合物，防御性碳化合物与叶片经济谱解耦。2) 根系在保守梯度上表现为生物活性碳与防御化合物的权衡；在协作梯度上（从“自主”土壤探索到菌根真菌协作），根结构碳水化合物比例与碳分子多样性权衡。[贡献] 首次在分子水平揭示了地上和地下多维经济性状空间的碳化学基础分化，为理解植物整体策略权衡和物种共存提供了新机制。[局限] 研究仅限13种亚热带树种，推广到其他生物群系需谨慎；未直接测量菌根定殖率等协作梯度实据。[精读] 方法部分碳官能团定量及与经典经济性状的关联分析值得参考，可启发将功能性状扩展到植物入侵或干扰响应的碳化学维度。

dynamicItems.title: Food systems transformation would reshape global agriculture
dynamicItems.abstract: Abstract Food systems are a major contributor to exceeding planetary boundaries 1–3 and poor quality diets are a key mortality risk globally 4 . Projected population and income growth could exacerbate these challenges 5 . In response, there are calls for transformation towards healthy and sustainable food systems 6–8 . However, the scale and distribution of the impacts of this transformation on agriculture are underexplored. Here we show that, by 2050, the transformation of food systems towards healthy diets (adoption of the EAT– Lancet reference diet), improved productivity and halving of food waste results in a fundamental restructuring of global agriculture, aspects of which break with historical trends. Scenario simulations using a multimodel ensemble of ten global economic models show a 6% median decrease in agricultural land (+1% to −26%) compared with 2020 levels. By 2050, agricultural production would be 17% lower than business-as-usual projections (−2% to −32%) and, economically, the value of this production is US$1.6 trillion (26%) lower (+8% to −58%). Within this, the value of livestock production would be substantially lower than current 2050 projections (−49% to −83%), while vegetable, fruit, nut and legume production value would increase by 23% (−33% to +106%). Results are dependent on the assumed policies to achieve the transformation scenario. We highlight a more active role for food policy to consider the benefits of such a transformation (improved population health and reduced environmental pressures) and navigate the political economy of its impacts.

dynamicItems.title: Growth, mortality and regeneration responses to ecological forestry treatments are shaped by local factors, species, and initial treatment impact
dynamicItems.abstract: Abstract Ecological forestry rooted in natural disturbance‐based silviculture (NDBS) aims to help maintain or facilitate recovery of ecosystem structure and function toward conditions found in unharvested stands. In the short term, leaving a portion of a stand's merchantable trees intact at harvest should increase similarity in composition and function relative to stands following non‐stand‐replacing natural disturbances such as low‐intensity fires, windthrow, or insect outbreaks and thus maintain biodiversity and other ecosystem services. Testing NDBS requires long‐term data, while assessing the generality of responses to NDBS requires such data from multiple experiments across diverse stand and site conditions. To date, our understanding of forest responses to NDBS has been limited by a lack of opportunities to explore responses across time. In this study, we utilized data from three long‐term experiments encompassing 21 combinations of harvest treatments by stand type plus unharvested reference stands. These experiments provide data to assess responses for 12 to 20 years post‐treatment. We quantified the direction (increasing or decreasing), duration (persisting or transient), magnitude, and temporal dynamics of responses in stand‐level tree growth, mortality, and regeneration abundances. High‐intensity treatments (≥40%) produced strong initial impacts, particularly increased tree mortality (although not statistically significant across all treatments), which in turn had prolonged effects on stand‐level growth through reduced tree density. These treatments also promoted increased broadleaf regeneration, likely due to greater canopy opening and enhanced light availability. We observed an inconsistent stand‐level growth response to treatments, with some treatments showing initial decline while others eventually resulted in higher growth in harvested stands. In mixed stands, coniferous species showed growth benefits when coexisting with broadleaf species, possibly due to reduced intraspecific competition or improved access to resources mediated by broadleaf neighbours. This growth advantage was not observed for broadleaf species, indicating asymmetric benefits in mixed stands. Response patterns and magnitude vary over time and are influenced by local factors such as stand type, overstory retention, species, and initial treatment impact. This variability highlights the potential for tailoring NDBS approaches locally to achieve desired outcomes and underscores the need to incorporate stand‐specific conditions into ecological forestry practices.
authors: Arun K. Bose, Suzanne Brais, K. David Coates, Brian D. Harvey, Richard Kabzems, Rongzhou Man, Charles Nock, Kevin A. Solarik, Manuella Strukelj, S. Ellen Macdonald
