dynamicItems.title: Plants are a powerful proxy for global tidal marsh methane fluxes
dynamicItems.abstract: Methane (CH 4 ) emissions can reduce the climate benefits of tidal marshes. Yet the drivers of tidal marsh CH 4 emissions remain poorly quantified, and salinity, the most well-established proxy for tidal marsh CH 4 fluxes, has low predictive performance. Here, we demonstrate that plant species out performs salinity as a single predictor of global tidal marsh CH 4 fluxes, providing a powerful and simple predictor on its own. A multiproxy approach combining plant species with other predictors (i.e., latitude, salinity, season) further improves predictions of global CH 4 fluxes. For our analysis, we compiled 87 studies with 2,094 mean measurements of CH 4 fluxes and used random forest and generalized additive modeling to investigate the relationship among CH 4 fluxes, salinity, and plants. We found that plant species was the most important predictor of CH 4 fluxes globally. Our model of plant species alone explained 62% of the variability in CH 4 fluxes and when including latitude, season, and soil salinity, explained 71%. We also developed a model with plant functional type for when plant species flux data are not available. We found that plant functional type alone explained 54% of the variability in CH 4 fluxes, underscoring the influential role of plants. Previously, polyhaline marshes were thought to have low CH 4 emissions. Here we show that CH 4 fluxes from these marshes offset between 1% and 39% of carbon sequestration, depending on the plant species present and selected global warming potential value. This plant species-based approach significantly improves global CH 4 flux estimates in tidal marshes and facilitates global carbon accounting.

dynamicItems.title: Optimising daily sampling of plant–bee interaction networks
dynamicItems.abstract: Abstract Plant–pollinator interactions are dynamic not only across seasons but also over hourly time scales, even beyond the day–night contrast. However, capturing the daily temporal variability of pollination networks during field data collection is challenging. Consequently, our understanding of daily variation in network composition and structure remains incomplete due to limited sampling coverage. Moreover, inaccurate sampling protocols can result in missing links that impair the identification of underlying processes and emerging patterns. We address this gap by studying the fine‐scale temporal organisation of the diverse diurnal plant–bee relationships and examining how the interaction composition and network structure fluctuate throughout the day. We extensively sampled plant–bee interactions in a Brazilian Cerrado over two flowering seasons, encompassing six 2‐h sampling periods throughout the day. We compared interaction β‐diversity and network structural properties across sampling periods. A factorial approach was used to merge interactions among all combinations of sampling periods to assess how the composition and structure of the partial‐day networks deviated from those exhibited by the full‐day network (i.e. consolidating all interactions). Plant–bee interactions exhibited notable variations in network metrics across daily sampling periods. From dawn to dusk, plant–bee networks showed reduced modularity and specialisation but greater nestedness. Interaction β‐diversity between sampling periods increased progressively with wider temporal intervals, mainly explained by interaction rewiring among shared species. Combining four 2‐h sampling periods recovered up to ~80% of all pairwise interactions and ~ 82% of interaction frequencies, and generated partial‐day networks that most closely resembled the structure of full‐day networks. These best‐performing combinations consistently drew from daily central hours, whereas early‐morning and late‐afternoon periods contributed fewer but unique interactions. Our study demonstrates that plant–bee interaction networks are time‐sensitive at the intraday scale and that interaction completeness is not necessarily improved by increasing effort within a single time window, but rather by distributing sampling across, or focusing on, the most informative periods of the day. We provide a general framework to evaluate how temporal sampling design affects network representativeness in systems where interactions depend on time‐of‐day.

dynamicItems.summary: [背景]植物-传粉者互作在一天内可发生小时尺度变化，但野外采样常以单一时段为主，导致日内互作变异被忽视，网络结构认知不完整，并可能影响对群落过程的推断。[方法]研究在巴西Cerrado两个开花季，于白天划分6个2小时时段进行植物-蜜蜂互作高强度抽样，通过比较时段间网络β多样性和结构属性（模块化、特化、嵌套性），并利用阶乘法合并不同时段数据，评估部分天数网络与全天完整网络的差异，以及恢复全部互作信息和网络结构所需的最优时段组合。[发现]1)网络指标在白天显著变化：从早到晚模块化和特化度下降、嵌套性上升；2)互作β多样性随时段间隔增大而增加，主要由物种重连驱动；3)合并四个2小时时段（约8小时）可恢复约80%的互作对和82%的互作频率，且生成的部分网络结构与全天网络最相似；4)最优时段组合集中于日间中心时段，清晨和傍晚贡献较少但独特的互作。[贡献]为传粉网络研究提供了首个系统性的日内动态评估和采样优化框架，可推广至其他时间敏感性互作系统。[局限]研究局限于单一生境（热带稀树草原）与日间时段，结论的外推性有待验证；未考虑夜间传粉者。[精读] 是否精读应依据自己的研究问题和方法需求判断。

dynamicItems.title: Biodiversity buffers the effects of drought on productivity most in drier grasslands and less so in forests
dynamicItems.abstract: Nature Ecology & Evolution, Published online: 15 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41559-026-03127-w We synthesized data from 75 biodiversity experiments across grasslands and forests worldwide to test how climate extremes and environmental context shape the effects of plant diversity on productivity. We found that the effects of plant diversity intensify in extreme drought and in more arid grasslands, driven by strengthened complementarity among species.
dynamicItems.summary: [背景] 极端气候事件（如干旱）对生态系统生产力构成严重威胁，而生物多样性被认为能够缓冲这些影响，但不同环境条件下多样性效应的强弱是否变化尚不清楚。[方法] 该研究综合了全球75个草地和森林的生物多样性实验数据，分析了植物多样性对干旱下生产力的影响，以及环境背景（如干旱指数）的调节作用。[发现] 1) 在极端干旱事件中，植物多样性对生产力的缓冲效应更强；2) 在更干旱的草地中，多样性效应更显著，主要表现为物种间的互补性增强；3) 在森林中，多样性效应对干旱的缓冲作用较弱，可能与森林生态系统的结构复杂性有关。[贡献] 揭示了多样性-稳定性关系的气候依赖性，为预测气候变化下不同生态系统对干旱的响应提供了机制理解。[局限] 研究基于实验数据，可能难以完全反映自然生态系统的复杂性；不同实验的干旱强度和频率定义不统一。[精读] 值得关注其综合分析方法和对功能性状机制的讨论。

dynamicItems.abstract: Nature Ecology & Evolution, Published online: 15 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41559-026-03130-1 Biodiversity effects on ecosystem functioning under climate extremes may depend on ecosystem type and baseline aridity. Here the authors show that the effects of plant diversity on productivity are strongest under extreme drought in more arid grasslands, whereas comparable context dependence is not detected in forests or under heat extremes.
dynamicItems.summary: [背景] 气候极端事件日益频繁，生物多样性被认为可缓冲生态系统功能下降，但这种效应在不同生态系统类型和不同干旱背景下有何差异尚不清楚。 [方法] 作者收集了全球多个生物多样性-生态系统功能实验的数据，涵盖草地和森林，分析植物物种丰富度对生产力（地上生物量）在不同气候极端事件（干旱和热浪）下的影响，并考虑站点背景干旱度。 [发现] 1）在草地中，生物多样性对生产力的正面效应在极端干旱下增强，且随着站点背景干旱度增加而增强；2）在森林中，无论干旱还是热浪，均未检测到生物多样性效应的系统变化；3）热浪事件下，草地与森林的生物多样性效应均未表现出背景依赖性。 [贡献] 揭示了生物多样性效应在气候极端事件下的生态系统类型和干旱背景依赖性，为预测气候变化下不同生态系统功能稳定性提供了新见解。 [局限] 全球实验数据覆盖不均，森林站点相对较少，且极端热浪事件观测有限；结果外推需谨慎。 [精读] 方法部分关于全球实验数据整合的筛选标准及统计模型值得参考，以理解这种跨生态系统比较的稳健性。

dynamicItems.title: Risks of heightened human–wildlife conflict when subsidies disappear
dynamicItems.abstract: Anthropogenic food subsidies often elevate wildlife populations. Reducing these subsidies may alter behavior more rapidly than population size, creating a transient period of heightened human–wildlife conflict. Recognizing these transitional dynamics can improve conflict mitigation and conservation outcomes while enhancing public safety for communities living alongside dangerous species.
dynamicItems.summary: [背景] 人为食物补贴（如垃圾、投喂）常导致野生动物种群增长，但减少这类补贴可能引发复杂的人-野生动物冲突。现有研究多关注补贴对种群数量的长期影响，较少关注补贴消失后行为改变的短期动态及其管理挑战。[方法] 本文为观点文章，基于现有案例和理论推导，分析补贴减少后野生动物行为改变的机制、后果及管理对策。[发现] 1) 补贴减少后，野生动物行为改变（如觅食策略调整）比种群数量下降更快，导致饥饿个体更频繁进入人类社区或攻击人畜，造成冲突短期急剧加剧；2) 这种过渡期可能被管理者忽视，从而采取不当应对（如扑杀），反而扩大冲突；3) 提前规划、逐步减少补贴、结合行为引导措施（如诱食替代）可缓解过渡期风险。[贡献] 提出冲突的“过渡动态”框架，强调行为与种群响应的不同步性，为冲突管理提供新视角。[局限] 为概念性探讨，缺乏实证数据支撑，具体阈值和持续时间因物种和环境而异，需个案评估。[精读] 讨论部分的管理启示值得快速浏览，但无需深入精读。

dynamicItems.title: Second-chance speciation in the Clouded Apollo butterfly
dynamicItems.abstract: Lancho-Silva et al. reveal two successive contacts between butterfly populations that capture the surprisingly rapid emergence of reproductive isolation driven by selection for chemical differences, a mechanism rarely documented in action. Their work demonstrates that Europe’s protected Clouded Apollo butterfly actually comprises two distinct species, with implications for conservation.

dynamicItems.summary: [背景] 欧洲受保护的Clouded Apollo蝴蝶（Parnassius mnemosyne）种群间可能存在隐蔽的物种分化，但快速物种形成的机制在自然种群中鲜有直接观察。 [方法] 该研究利用两次独立的种群接触事件（具体实验设计信息不足，需查原文确认），分析行为隔离和化学信号差异在生殖隔离中的作用。 [发现] 研究发现该蝴蝶实际包含两个形态难以区分的隐存物种；生殖隔离在短时间内迅速建立，驱动力来自化学通讯物质（如性信息素）的差异选择，这一“二次物种形成”过程在行动中被捕捉到。 [贡献] 提供了自然界中化学信号驱动的快速物种形成罕见案例，挑战了生殖隔离需要长时间积累的传统观点，并直接提示需重新评估该保护物种的分类和管理单元。 [局限] 摘要未说明样本量、地理覆盖范围和分析方法等关键细节；行为实验和化学分析的稳健性需查阅全文评估。 [精读] 若关注快速物种形成和化学通讯进化，可重点精读其行为选择实验设计和化学特征比较方法部分。

dynamicItems.title: Transboundary protected areas for freshwater biodiversity
dynamicItems.abstract: Recently, Li et al. [1] initiated an important discussion about the role of transboundary protected areas (TBPAs) in biodiversity conservation, nature’s contributions to people, and cultural values. Their study opened an opportunity to broaden the discussion on freshwater biodiversity. This is essential because, for a long time and across many regions of the world, freshwater ecosystems, which have high levels of biodiversity, have been neglected when creating protected areas [e.g., 2–4]. Paradoxically, freshwater biodiversity is extremely threatened [e.g., 5] and, therefore, needs to be targeted in conservation strategies such as TBPAs [4].
authors: Valter M. Azevedo-Santos, Felipe P. Ottoni
dynamicItems.summary: [背景] 跨界保护区（TBPAs）已被探讨在生物多样性保护、自然对人类贡献和文化价值方面的作用，但淡水生物多样性长期被保护规划忽视。淡水生态系统拥有高水平的生物多样性，却面临极高威胁，亟需纳入保护策略。[方法] 本文为观点评论，基于Li等近期发起的讨论，强调将淡水维度整合进跨界保护区框架的必要性，通过总结已有文献指出代表性不足的问题。[发现] 1) 全球范围内，淡水生态系统在保护区网络中代表性严重不足；2) 淡水生物多样性受到多重胁迫，跨界合作保护是关键；3) 在TBPAs中明确纳入淡水目标可提升整体保护成效。[贡献] 文章开辟了跨界保护区讨论的新方向，提醒保护学界关注淡水生态系统的独特性与紧迫性。[局限] 作为简评，未提供经验数据或具体实施路线，分析依赖已发表研究，深度有限。[精读] 值得快速浏览以获取概念启发，但核心论据需追溯引用的实证文献。

dynamicItems.title: Dielectric levitation optical tweezers for powerful mesoscale biomanipulation
dynamicItems.abstract: Optical tweezers (OT), a cornerstone of micromanipulation, are fundamentally constrained by substrate-induced adhesion and friction, limiting their application to mesoscale objects and fragile biological specimens where overcoming these resistive forces requires physiologically damaging laser powers. Here, we overcome this long-standing challenge by introducing dielectric levitation optical tweezers (DL-OT), a multiphysics platform that seamlessly integrates alternating-current dielectric levitation with optical traps. By using negative dielectrophoresis (n-DEP) to actively neutralize the normal force, DL-OT eliminates solid – solid contact and near-wall viscous drag. Crucially, we demonstrate the fundamental superiority of this active physical levitation over traditional passive antiadhesion coatings. This physical decoupling enables the smooth translation of large biological samples using low, biologically safe optical powers (~15 mW) rather than nonviable levels (>150 mW). The creation of this frictionless environment not only boosts the maximum manipulation speed of standard microtargets by 40% but also enables the stable optical transport of previously intractable mesoscale objects (100 to 260 μm), including microgears and shrimp eggs. By preventing photothermal damage and mechanical deformation, DL-OT demonstrates very good biocompatibility, significantly enhancing cell viability postmanipulation. Building upon these advantages, we demonstrate advanced on-chip biofabrication protocols through the targeted, high-precision assembly of multicellular spheroids and the safe transport of patient-derived organoids, followed by their success in situ culture. By transforming OT from a microscale tool into a mesoscale assembly platform, DL-OT paves the way for breakthroughs in tissue engineering, regenerative medicine, and the bottom – up assembly of living systems.

dynamicItems.title: Ecological and Evolutionary Consequences of Parasitism
dynamicItems.abstract: Parasitism is an interaction defined by negative exploitation of one organism by another. However, the effects of parasites extend far beyond harm to a single individual. In this review, we explore three distinct pathways by which parasite effects on individual hosts translate into profound consequences at higher scales of biological organization. First, parasite-associated changes in individual host traits, including morphology, physiology, behavior, and life history, affect survival and reproduction, with consequences for host population densities and genotypic and phenotypic distributions. Second, changes in host densities affect ecological and evolutionary processes at the community and ecosystem levels. Third, changes in host traits independently affect communities and ecosystems. We illustrate each pathway using examples spanning the effects of parasites on host populations, communities, and ecosystems. This holistic approach showcases the discordant effects parasites can have across scales. We conclude with a discussion of open research questions, highlighting opportunities for studying the consequences of parasitism as a multiscale phenomenon.

dynamicItems.summary: [背景] 寄生是生物间负向利用的相互作用，但其影响常远超个体层面的危害，现有研究对寄生在多尺度上的生态与进化后果缺乏整合。 [方法] 本文为综述，从三个递进途径梳理文献：1）寄生引起宿主个体性状变化（形态、生理、行为、生活史）进而影响种群动态和遗传结构；2）宿主种群密度改变对群落与生态系统的级联效应；3）宿主性状变化独立地影响群落与生态系统。 [发现] 1）寄生可通过降低宿主生存率或繁殖力直接压制种群数量，也能通过改变宿主行为（如觅食、反捕食）间接影响种间关系；2）寄生效应在不同尺度上常出现不一致甚至相反的结果，如对个体有害但对种群或群落稳定有促进作用；3）案例涵盖多种宿主-寄生系统，包括动物、植物和微生物，展示了寄生在调节生态系统功能（如初级生产力、营养循环）中的角色。 [贡献] 提出分析寄生后果的多尺度框架，强调超越单一尺度的整合视角，为未来研究指明方向，尤其呼吁关注寄生在群落构建和生态系统功能中的普适机制。 [局限] 基于文献综述，未提供新数据或定量分析；案例多为动物系统，植物和微生物寄生的讨论相对薄弱；多尺度动态的预测模型尚待建立。 [精读] 若对寄生在群落和生态系统层面的间接效应感兴趣，可精读文中关于宿主性状介导的间接通路部分及未来研究方向。

dynamicItems.title: Latitudinal patterns in growth and defence against multiple enemies of an invasive species and its native congener
dynamicItems.abstract: Abstract Some invasive plant species rapidly develop latitudinal patterns of growth and defence against herbivores in their introduced ranges, either parallel to or different from those of co‐occurring native plant species. However, how defences against multiple enemies relate to latitude and environmental drivers for co‐occurring native and invasive plant species remains uncertain. We assessed latitudinal patterns in growth and defences against multiple enemies for the invasive species Alternanthera philoxeroides and its native congener A. sessilis in China, with surveys of natural populations and a common garden experiment with ~50 populations. We explored how plant growth and defences were associated with source site environments. In natural populations, foliar defoliation and pathogen infection peaked at intermediate latitude, while herbivore richness and abundance, richness of overall rhizosphere fungi and pathogens decreased with latitude for both species. In the common garden, native species' growth decreased with source population latitude, while native plant resistance against the dominant insect herbivore and root‐knot nematode parasite increased with source latitude. Invasive species' growth and defences were unrelated to source population latitude. Resistance to a common foliar fungal pathogen did not vary with source population latitude for either species. Traits of native plants were consistent with direct effects of climate while those of invasive plants only reflected indirect effects. Synt hesis. The results underscore the latitudinal variability of biotic interactions across organisms and highlight how a species' growth and defence across latitude are not influenced by herbivores alone, but a suite of enemies and abiotic conditions.
authors: Biao Zhu, Yifan He, Lunlun Gao, Chunqiang Wei, Hao Xu, Xiaoyan Liu, Jiatao Xie, Zhijie Zhang, Joshua S. Lynn, Evan Siemann, Xinmin Lu
dynamicItems.summary: [背景] 入侵植物在新分布区常快速形成与本地种平行或不同的生长和防御纬度格局，但针对多种敌人（植食者、病原菌）的防御如何随纬度变化及其与环境驱动关系尚不确定。[方法] 该研究以入侵中国的喜旱莲子草及本地同属种莲子草为对象，通过自然种群调查和涵盖约50个种群的同质园实验，评估了生长及对多种敌人防御的纬度格局，并分析植物性状与来源地环境的关系。[发现] 1) 野外种群中，两种植物的叶片取食和病原感染在中间纬度最高，而植食者丰富度和丰度、根际真菌和病原菌丰富度均随纬度降低。2) 同质园中，本地种生长随来源地纬度升高而下降，但对主要昆虫植食者和根结线虫的抗性随纬度升高而增强。3) 入侵种的生长和防御与来源地纬度均无显著关系。4) 对常见叶部真菌病原的抗性在两种植物中均不随纬度变化。5) 本地种性状直接受气候影响，而入侵种性状仅体现间接效应。[贡献] 首次系统比较入侵种与本地同属种对多种敌人的防御纬度格局，揭示了生物互作纬度变异的复杂性，并强调入侵物种的响应并非由植食者单一驱动。[局限] 研究局限于中国纬度梯度，敌人类型虽多但未量化不同敌人的相对重要性；同质园环境可能未完全反映野外条件。[精读] 值得精读其实验设计、性状测量和纬度分析方法，对入侵生态比较研究有借鉴意义。

dynamicItems.title: Plant Invasions and Their Impacts Under Global Environmental Change
dynamicItems.abstract: As one of the major global change factors (GCFs), plant invasions could be influenced by other GCFs, forming complex feedbacks that impact native ecosystems. This review synthesizes current knowledge on how GCFs influence nonnative plant invasions via direct effects on invasiveness and community invasibility, as well as indirect effects operating through mutualists, antagonists, and altered trophic networks. Critical research gaps involve the interactive effects of multiple GCFs (three or more), environmental variability, emerging GCFs, and systemic biases in study systems. Predictive models provide probabilistic, but still decision-relevant, forecasts of invasion risk under global change. Research priorities include multifactor and long-term experiments, explicit consideration of belowground mechanisms and trophic feedbacks, and the reformulation of invasion hypotheses within a global-change framework. These directions are critical not only for understanding nonnative plant invasions but also for managing range-shifting species in an increasingly dynamic world.

dynamicItems.title: Spatiotemporally controlled matrix softening facilitates deterministic crypt formation in human intestinal organoids
dynamicItems.abstract: Spatially controlling morphogenesis is a challenge for many organoid systems that manifests as a limited understanding of self-organization of differentiating cells and leads to a high degree of heterogeneity in organoid morphometrics. Current methods to grow organoids rely on temporal presentation of soluble cues that are not controllably delivered, and little is known about the role of the extracellular microenvironment in this process. Here, we present a material-based strategy to spatiotemporally control morphogenesis of human intestinal organoids (HIOs) with predictable crypt morphometrics and cell composition that match their in vivo tissue counterparts. We first optimize culture conditions to generate more reproducible HIOs with predictable growth in phototunable poly (ethylene glycol)-based hydrogels, and then systematically investigate the role of light-mediated matrix softening in guiding crypt formation. The light dose delivered to crypt-sized regions adjacent to growing organoids is a key factor in maintaining organoid cell viability, as well as crypt budding and elongation. With optimized light doses, predictable epithelial shape changes result in programmable crypt formation, confirmed by the presence of proliferative (Ki67+) and niche-defining Paneth (Lyz+) cells. This methodology could be readily adopted for other budding and branching organoids to facilitate controllable changes in morphogenesis or cell migration. Sequential patterning approaches and more complex pattern designs could further open the parameter space to facilitate modeling of a wide array of engineered tissues for applications ranging from fundamental biology to disease modeling and translational medicine.

dynamicItems.title: Trait responses to competition are mostly parallel among competitor plants but can cause convergence or divergence in key traits
dynamicItems.abstract: Abstract Plants competing for resources exhibit different traits than plants which are not. Phenotypic plasticity can shape competition by altering trait differences between competitors. Studies show that plastic traits may converge or diverge among competitors as competition intensifies. However, another possibility is that interacting species could exhibit similar trait shifts as competition intensifies (trait parallelism). We used a field experiment to assess trait responses and performance outcomes for six co‐occurring native and invasive annual California grassland species when grown together at various densities. We grew one focal individual of each species in each plot and manipulated the identity and density of competitors, from bare ground to a dense lawn. Species displayed many trait responses to competitor density, which depended on competitor identity more than focal species identity. Most trait responses were parallel among competing plants with no effect on trait differences between competitors. The exceptions were specific root length, which diverged among competitors with increased competitor density, root mass fraction and leaf dry matter content, which both converged among competitors with increased competitor density. Competitors' effects on performance were not correlated with greater responses in any trait. A few traits displayed non‐parallel responses among competing plants, altering trait differences between competitors. These traits may be of interest for future studies of plasticity's effects on competition or species coexistence. Read the free Plain Language Summary for this article on the Journal blog.
authors: Julia Bebout, Juliana Loaiza, Alexander Gillert, Elsa Cleland

dynamicItems.title: Bridging the divide between models of animal‐driven and microbial‐driven biogeochemical cycling: A zoogeochemistry‐informed framework
dynamicItems.abstract: Abstract Most current terrestrial biogeochemical models formalize biogeochemical cycling as predominantly controlled by processes involving plants and soil microbes. However, growing evidence indicates that above‐ground animals could exert controlling feedback effects that alter soil microbial performance via trophic interactions on plants, release of chemicals in waste matter deposition, and biophysical impacts on soil properties. We present a conceptual and mathematical framework—a Coupled Aboveground‐Belowground Zoogeochemical (CAB–ZGC) cycling model—that explicitly links above‐ground animal direct and feedback effects in models of below‐ground processes. We then provide an empirical synthesis, informed by the conceptual framework, to quantify the potential direction and magnitude of vertebrate and invertebrate animal impacts on below‐ground microbial processes. The synthesis of 39 studies provides proof‐of‐concept showing that animal presence can alter key biogeochemical processes including soil nutrient availability for microbes, microbial and fungal activity, microbial litter processing, and carbon and nitrogen cycling by between 10% to 219% relative to their absence. Effects were enhancing in 65% of cases, and reducing in 35%, and invertebrate density was a strong predictor of the effect and magnitude for microbial activity and nitrogen cycling. These findings reveal the importance of considering animal effects in biogeochemical models to improve the accuracy of model predictions and empirical assessments of biogeochemical cycling in ecosystems. We conclude by highlighting two complementary research fronts to advance terrestrial biogeochemical models: (i) model development through case studies to build a more general CAB‐ZGS model and (ii) target empirical work to measure animal parameters including flux rates, forage intake, animal respiration and waste across a range of animal densities and contexts. Read the free Plain Language Summary for this article on the Journal blog.
authors: Janey R. Lienau, Nathalie R. Sommer, Oswald J. Schmitz
dynamicItems.summary: [背景] 现有陆地生物地球化学模型主要聚焦植物和土壤微生物，但地上动物可通过营养级联、排泄物沉积和土壤物理扰动等反馈显著影响地下过程，然而缺乏整合动物效应的模型框架。[方法] 本文提出耦合地上-地下动物地球化学（CAB-ZGC）循环的概念与数学模型，明确连接动物直接效应与地下微生物过程。同时综合39项实证研究，量化动物对土壤微生物过程的影响方向和幅度。[发现] 1) 动物存在可使土壤养分有效性、微生物活性、凋落物分解及碳氮循环变化10%–219%；2) 65%的案例为增强效应，35%为减弱；3) 无脊椎动物密度是微生物活性和氮循环效应的强预测因子。[贡献] 首次提供将动物效应纳入生物地球化学模型的通用框架，并给出定量证据，为提升模型预测精度开辟新路径。[局限] 模型尚属概念阶段，需更多案例和参数（如通量率、采食量）以构建通用模型；实证综合仅纳入39项研究，可能不具普遍性。[精读] 模型构建思路和参数化方法值得参考，建议精读模型方程与实证综合部分。

dynamicItems.title: Above‐ground and below‐ground productivity shows divergent compensatory responses to grazing in an alpine grassland
dynamicItems.abstract: Abstract The grazing optimization hypothesis suggests that moderate herbivory can stimulate plant growth and increase productivity, a phenomenon referred to as overcompensation. However, most evidence for this response is based on above‐ground responses, while below‐ground responses remain uncertain. Below‐ground productivity accounts for more than half of total grassland productivity, making it essential to assess whole‐plant responses. We conducted a 3‐year yak grazing‐intensity experiment, manipulating four levels of herbivory, and quantified compensation indices for both above‐ground (ANPP) and below‐ground (BNPP) net primary productivity relative to ungrazed controls. We complemented this with a controlled simulated‐grazing experiment to isolate the effects of defoliation, trampling and excrement on these compensation responses. Across light, moderate and heavy grazing treatments, ANPP increased by 28%–43% relative to ungrazed controls, suggesting clear overcompensation in above‐ground production. In contrast, BNPP showed little response to grazing intensity and exhibited only limited compensatory responses, such that total net primary productivity (NPP) showed only weak overcompensation. Over time, the magnitude of ANPP overcompensation declined, whereas no temporal attenuation was detected for BNPP or total NPP. Results from the simulated‐grazing experiment further showed that defoliation alone increased ANPP, while trampling and excreta return had negligible effects on ANPP, BNPP or their associated compensation indices. Synthesis . Our findings suggest that reliance on aboveground‐only measurements systematically overestimates the degree of overcompensation in grazed grasslands, underscoring the necessity of whole‐plant assessments for accurately evaluating grassland productivity.
authors: Hongbiao Zi, Xin Jing, Hao Wang, Bai Yue, Huijie Gu, Zhenhua Zhang, Jin‐Sheng He
dynamicItems.summary: [背景] 放牧优化假说认为适度采食可刺激植物生长，但以往验证多基于地上部分，地下生产力占草地总生产力一半以上，其补偿响应尚不明确。完整评估地上-地下补偿效应对草地可持续管理至关重要。[方法] 在青藏高原高寒草地开展3年牦牛放牧强度实验（无放牧、轻牧、中牧、重牧），并辅以控制模拟放牧实验分离去叶、踩踏和排泄物的独立影响，计算地上(ANPP)和地下(BNPP)净初级生产力的补偿指数。[发现] 1) 轻、中、重度放牧使ANPP较不放牧对照增加28%–43%，表现为显著过补偿；2) BNPP对放牧强度响应微弱，仅出现有限的补偿，导致总NPP仅呈微弱过补偿；3) ANPP过补偿幅度随时间下降，但BNPP与总NPP无此时间衰减；4) 模拟实验表明，去叶单独增加ANPP，踩踏与排泄物返回对ANPP、BNPP及补偿指数均无显著影响。[贡献] 首次综合证明高寒草地地上和地下生产力对放牧的补偿响应显著背离，警示仅依靠地上测量会系统性地高估补偿程度，为准确评估放牧草地生产力提供了全株视角。[局限] 3年周期可能未充分捕捉长期动态，模拟实验因子单一，且未涉及植物群落组成变化的间接效应。[精读] 推荐精读实验设计部分及补偿差异背后的碳分配机制讨论。

dynamicItems.title: Plant populations in ancient grasslands harbour higher levels of genetic diversity
dynamicItems.abstract: Abstract Land‐use change and intensification can be a threat to biodiversity of grassland habitats, including genetic diversity. This is especially true for areas where drastic changes in land use occurred in recent years. The Allgäu in Germany is known for a large proportion of grassland in its landscape. However, the sites often differ in their current management intensity and their land use history. While some sites have been used as grasslands for more than two centuries, other grasslands are much younger. We assumed that landscape history and grassland management have a significant impact on genetic variation and therefore analysed the genetic variation of five typical grassland species using multiplexed ISSR (inter‐simple sequence repeat) genotyping by sequencing (MIG‐seq). We then related data on genetic variation with data on habitat quality, landscape structure and habitat age to identify possible drivers of genetic variation. Our results indicated a high level of gene flow across the study area. Consequently, genetic differentiation among populations was correlated with geographic distance. Genetic diversity clearly depended on habitat age but was not related to habitat conditions or landscape structure. Synthesis and applications . Since ancient grasslands harbour genetically more diverse plant populations, land use history should be given more attention in conservation management.
authors: Lena Winkler, Vinzenz Gilgenreiner, Hannah Schmitt, Christoph Reisch
dynamicItems.summary: [背景] 草地生境受土地利用变化和集约化威胁，遗传多样性丧失成为重要问题，尤其在近年土地用途剧烈变化区域。德国Allgäu地区以大面积草地闻名，但各斑块在管理强度和土地利用历史上差异显著：部分草地已有200年以上历史，其余则较为年轻。研究假设景观历史和草地管理对植物遗传变异有重要影响。 [方法] 利用多重ISSR基因分型测序（MIG-seq）技术，测定了五种典型草地物种的遗传变异，并关联生境质量、景观结构和生境年龄数据，识别遗传变异的驱动因素。 [发现] 1) 研究区域内基因流水平高，种群间遗传分化与地理距离相关。2) 遗传多样性显著依赖于生境年龄（草地越古老遗传多样性越高），而与当前生境条件或景观结构无显著关系。 [贡献] 首次明确证明草地年龄对植物遗传多样性的独立影响，为保护管理中重视土地利用历史提供了直接证据。 [局限] 研究物种仅五种常见草地植物，推广至稀有或不同功能群物种时需谨慎；基因流模式可能受区域特异性影响。 [精读] 方法部分MIG-seq的应用和遗传多样性-年龄关系分析值得参考，讨论部分关于古老草地保护优先级的见解有实践意义。

dynamicItems.title: Sea level rise weakens the restoration benefit of mussel–cordgrass facilitation in salt marshes
dynamicItems.abstract: Abstract Ribbed mussels are ecosystem engineers that can enhance the performance of Spartina alterniflora and contribute to shoreline protection, but it remains unclear how mussel facilitation of cordgrass growth and associated stability benefits vary across inundation gradients expected under accelerating sea level rise. Identifying where this facilitation strengthens or weakens along the elevation gradient is, therefore, essential for anticipating restoration outcomes and designing interventions that leverage biotic interactions under future inundation regimes. We conducted a field mesocosm experiment on the Louisiana coast using marsh organs planted with S. alterniflora . We exposed the plants to five elevation treatments ( E = +5, 0, −5, −10 and −15 cm relative to the present marsh surface) to generate an inundation gradient spanning a low‐inundation hindcast, present‐day conditions and future relative elevation scenarios under sea level rise, and we crossed these elevations with four ribbed mussel ( Geukensia granosissima ) density treatments ( N = 0, 254, 509 and 1018 individuals m −2 ). Our results showed that mussel–cordgrass facilitation was strongly dependent on relative elevation: increasing mussel density enhanced plant biomass accumulation only within a distinct ‘facilitation window’ where elevation keeps pace with sea level rise (+5 to 0 cm relative elevation). At relative elevations of −5 cm and lower, the positive mussel–cordgrass interaction weakened rapidly, forming a ‘decoupling zone’. Structural equation modelling further suggested that greater realized mussel biomass was associated with higher soil organic matter and below‐ground biomass, whereas greater inundation frequency was associated with higher soil water content and lower soil organic matter and below‐ground biomass. Synthesis and applications. Within a limited elevation range near the present marsh surface, ribbed mussels facilitate S. alterniflora biomass accumulation; however, this facilitative interaction is contingent on relative elevation and is likely to weaken as relative elevation declines under future sea level rise. Consequently, relative elevation provides a practical screening metric for marsh restoration efforts, helping to prioritize locations for incorporating ribbed mussels where benefits to cordgrass biomass are most likely and to avoid settings where expected benefits are low. This screening metric can inform marsh restoration project siting, monitoring and adaptive management under future sea level rise.
authors: Yaolin Guo, Skylar L. Demourelle, Megan K. La Peyre, Brian J. Roberts

dynamicItems.title: Tree canopy shapes the survival of oak and beech saplings during the regeneration stage along an elevation‐driven temperature gradient
dynamicItems.abstract: Abstract Climate change is increasing the severity and frequency of heatwave and drought events, affecting forest community composition through changes in the mediating microclimatic effect of dominant adult trees. Predicting these changes requires understanding how temperature interacts with biotic factors, such as canopy‐mediated facilitation and competition, during forest regeneration. Here, we investigate how the forest canopy modifies temperature‐ and light‐related constraints on sapling survival along an elevation gradient. We conducted a reciprocal transplant experiment using saplings of Fagus sylvatica and Quercus petraea along an elevation‐driven temperature gradient (100–1600 m) in the French Pyrenees. Saplings were planted under two tree‐neighbour conditions, under forest canopy and in open gaps, allowing analysis of the effects of temperature, canopy cover and their interactions on survival. The experimentally derived survival‐temperature relationships were then used to generate spatial projections of canopy effects on sapling survival under a warming scenario. Sapling survival declined with increasing elevation for both species, but responses differed between canopy conditions and species. Q. petraea survival decreased sharply under canopy at high elevation, whereas F. sylvatica showed reduced survival in open gaps at the lowest elevation. These patterns reflect contrasting biotic interactions along the thermal gradient: canopy competition constrains Q. petraea at high elevations due to heat limitation, while canopy facilitation benefits F. sylvatica at the lowest elevation by buffering heat and vapour pressure deficit. Spatial projections under climate warming suggested improved canopy effect for both species at lower elevations, whereas at higher elevations Q. petraea benefits from canopy, but F. sylvatica experiences degraded effects. Our findings highlight the key role of strain— the degree to which local conditions deviate from a species' physiological optimum — in shaping competitive and facilitative interactions. While environmental stress sets the external constraint, species strain determines whether the canopy cover functions as a buffer or an inhibitor. Synthesis . By altering microclimatic conditions, the tree canopy can either alleviate or intensify strain depending on the species, thus influencing sapling survival and establishment along thermal gradients. Our results underscore the need to explicitly account for biotic interactions in models of species distribution and forest regeneration under climate warming.

dynamicItems.summary: [背景] 气候变化加剧热浪和干旱事件，优势成年树木的微气候调节效应可能改变森林群落组成，预测这些变化需要理解温度与生物因素（如冠层介导的促进和竞争）在森林更新中的相互作用。[方法] 作者在法国比利牛斯山100–1600 m海拔梯度上，对欧洲山毛榉(Fagus sylvatica)和无梗花栎(Quercus petraea)幼苗进行了交互移植实验，分别在林冠下和林窗开阔地两种邻体条件下种植，分析温度、冠层覆盖及二者交互作用对存活的影响，并利用存活-温度关系进行气候变暖情景下的空间投影。[发现] 1) 两种幼苗存活率都随海拔升高而下降，但物种间响应不同：栎树在高海拔林冠下存活率急剧降低，而山毛榉在低海拔林窗中存活率下降。2) 这些格局反映沿热梯度相反的生物互作：高海拔处热量受限，栎树遭受冠层竞争；低海拔处高温和蒸汽压差较大，山毛榉受益于冠层庇护。3) 空间投影显示，变暖下低海拔两种苗木的冠层效应均有改善，高海拔处栎树受益但山毛榉效应弱化。[贡献] 引入“strain”概念——局地条件偏离物种生理最适点的程度——来解释胁迫梯度上促进和竞争的转换，强调物种自身的胁迫感受而非单纯环境胁迫决定冠层功能。[局限] 研究仅关注存活，未考虑生长或繁殖；仅两个树种，结论外推需谨慎；实验期未能完全涵盖极端气候年。[精读] 方法部分的交互移植实验设计及“strain”框架值得精读，对理解物种分布模型中纳入生物互作有借鉴。

dynamicItems.title: Adaptational lag at high elevations depends on life stage in a California wildflower
dynamicItems.abstract: Abstract High‐elevation populations are expected to receive reduced snowpack, warmer temperatures and more variable precipitation with climate change, potentially putting them at risk if rates of adaptation do not keep pace. Populations from climates more closely aligned with changing conditions at high elevations may prove better suited to current climate than the local populations. Thus, it is essential to assess (1) whether high‐elevation populations are locally adapted to current climate or (2) whether the fitness of lower elevation populations from warmer climates is higher than for local populations in high‐elevation conditions. We conducted a common garden study with Streptanthus tortuosus at a high‐elevation site. Plants from twenty‐three populations from across the species range, which vary in climate and life history, were transplanted and subsequently measured for mortality and reproductive output across two growing seasons. We examined the effects of climatic distance from the site of origin on plant performance. We hypothesized that lower elevation populations would survive the first warm growth season well, but the seasonal constraint of cold temperatures and snowpack would reduce their survival into the second year, thus limiting their overall fitness. We observed evidence of adaptational lag for high‐elevation populations, including the local population, but only for some life stages. Lower elevation populations, with climates further from the garden, had higher survival through the first year and over winter, resulting in higher probabilities of reproducing and total fitness. However, survival to reproduction in year 2, and total reproductive output, driven largely by reproduction in the second year, were higher in high‐elevation populations, with climates closer to the garden. Thus, adaptational lag differed among life stages and depended on life history (e.g. first year versus second year fitness). Synthesis . Our results highlight the importance of considering variation in life history and seasonal timing when evaluating climate adaptation, as well as vulnerability of high‐elevation populations to climate change. Further, these findings provide information for management of populations at risk, including strategic assisted gene flow that introduces beneficial alleles from warm‐adapted populations but preserves some components of high‐elevation adaptation.
authors: Brandie Quarles‐Chidyagwai, Sarah Ashlock, Johanna Schmitt, Julin N. Maloof, Jennifer R. Gremer
dynamicItems.summary: [背景] 气候变化导致高海拔地区积雪减少、气温升高和降水变异性增加，若适应速率跟不上，高海拔种群可能面临风险。来自低海拔、气候更接近未来条件的种群是否在高海拔表现更好尚不清楚。[方法] 对加州野花 Streptanthus tortuosus 开展高海拔共同园实验，移植来自全分布区气候和生活史各异的23个种群，连续两季记录存活和繁殖输出，分析气候距离对表现的影响。[发现] 1) 无论是高海拔本地种群还是其它高海拔种群，均存在适应滞后，但仅表现在某些生活史阶段；2) 低海拔种群在第一年存活率和越冬存活率更高，总适合度更高；3) 第二年的存活至繁殖比例和总繁殖输出（主要由第二年繁殖贡献）在高海拔种群中更高；4) 适应滞后因生活史阶段（如一年生与多年生投资）而异，取决于季节性时机。[贡献] 强调在评估气候适应及高海拔种群脆弱性时，必须考虑生活史变异和季节动态，为辅助基因流等保护管理提供依据。[局限] 研究基于单一物种和单一高海拔园点，结论的普遍性需更多物种和地点验证。[精读] 是否精读应依据自己的研究问题和方法需求判断。

dynamicItems.title: Beauty, but at what cost? Ornamental weirs fragment China's streams
dynamicItems.abstract: In rivers across China, ornamental weirs are being installed to facilitate rural revitalization and promote eco‐tourism. Despite the goal of improving landscape aesthetics, these structures have ecological impacts—particularly on river connectivity—that may be substantial but are largely undocumented. In this study, we use Chinese social media and high‐resolution satellite images to quantify river fragmentation caused by ornamental weirs. These structures are present in at least 87 sub‐basins across China and result in intensive river fragmentation, with a median density of 0.95 barriers per kilometer and a dendritic connectivity index of 18.0 (95% confidence interval: 10.0–21.0). Notably, as compared with large dams, ornamental weirs occur in significantly higher densities and cause greater reductions in connectivity. While landscape aesthetics undoubtedly benefit local tourism, developers of ornamental weirs should seek not to jeopardize effective river connectivity, which supports the freshwater biodiversity and fisheries on which local communities depend.
authors: Jingrui Sun, Yingyue He, Chengfei Yi, Julian D Olden, Huiying Yang, Martyn C Lucas

dynamicItems.summary: [背景] 在中国，为促进乡村振兴和生态旅游，河流中大量建设装饰性堰，但其对河流连通性的生态影响尚未被系统评估。[方法] 本研究利用中国社交媒体平台（如抖音、小红书）提取装饰性堰的图片和位置信息，并结合高分辨率卫星影像验证和补充，在全国尺度上量化了装饰性堰造成的河流碎片化程度。计算了每个子流域的障碍物密度和树状连通性指数（DCI）。[发现] 1) 装饰性堰广泛分布于至少87个子流域，其密度中位数为每公里0.95个，DCI中位数为18.0（95% CI: 10.0–21.0），指示高强度碎片化。2) 与大型水坝相比，装饰性堰的密度显著更高，导致的连通性下降幅度更大，说明小型障碍物累积效应不可忽视。3) 装饰性堰建设多集中于旅游热点区域，景观收益与生态成本之间存在明显权衡。[贡献] 首次量化了装饰性堰对中国河流系统的碎片化影响，揭示了其隐蔽且累积的生态风险，为河流管理提供了决策依据。[局限] 数据来源依赖于互联网众包，可能遗漏未在社交媒体出现的堰；未进行现场验证，无法评估对鱼类洄游等实际生态过程的定量影响。[精读] 方法部分展示了利用多源遥感与社交媒体数据量化人为干扰的创新路径，值得参考；讨论部分对权衡的论述可启发保护规划。

dynamicItems.title: Experimental drought drives divergent succession of soil microbiota
dynamicItems.abstract: As droughts become increasingly severe and prolonged worldwide, understanding how belowground biodiversity changes over time under water limitation is critical for assessing ecosystem resilience. However, long-term and continuous observations of soil microbial responses to drought remain rare. Here, using a 6-y experimental drought in a tallgrass prairie ecosystem, we showed that experimental drought reshaped the community compositions of soil bacteria, fungi, and protists, accompanied by progressive declines in microbial diversity and biomass. Analyses of time–decay relationships and paired community differences between drought and ambient conditions revealed increasingly divergent successional trajectories of soil microbiota under drought. Although stochastic processes dominated community assembly overall, their relative importance declined over time, particularly for bacteria in drought-treated soils, suggesting increasingly strong deterministic environmental filtering imposed by drought. In addition, drought reduced microbial network size but increased the complexity and stability of bacterial networks by favoring drought-tolerant taxa. Furthermore, drought-driven shifts in microbial community compositions significantly altered functional genes and associated ecosystem functioning. These findings suggest that microbial communities may become less variable but more vulnerable, and the detrimental effects of biodiversity loss on ecosystems could be more severe in an increasingly drought-prone world.

dynamicItems.title: Fusarium oxysporum –induced ABA signaling triggers root vascular remodeling for plant defense
dynamicItems.abstract: Root vascular pathogens like Fusarium oxysporum (Fo) severely impact agriculture by colonizing the xylem, thereby disrupting the transport of water, nutrients, and signaling molecules within host plants. However, their effects on root growth and vascular development before xylem invasion, and the underlying molecular mechanisms, remain poorly understood. Here, we show that Fo triggers a rapid, systemic, abscisic acid (ABA) that seems to induce a developmental reprogramming in Arabidopsis that occurs prior to vascular colonization. This response is associated with root growth inhibition, disorganization of the root apical meristem, and alterations in xylem architecture. High-resolution imaging reveals that initial contact with Fo elevates root ABA levels, which parallels the modulation of key developmental pathways, including MIR165/PHB and VND7, which regulate vascular patterning and mediate premature xylem differentiation and remodeling. Phloem development is also affected, likely through disruption of CLE45–BAM3 signaling. Mutants impaired in endodermal ABA signaling, ELTPp:: abi1-1 , and secondary wall formation, cesa4, show constitutive elevated ABA levels, xylem defects, and enhanced resistance to Fo, suggesting that ABA-induced vascular remodeling contributes to the formation of structural barriers that limit infection. Additionally, Fo infection induces homogalacturonan demethylation in the stele, a modification associated with cell wall stiffening and reduced pathogen spread, which is constitutively observed in ELTPp:: abi1-1 . Overall, our findings reveal ABA-mediated vascular plasticity, including cell wall remodeling as a developmentally encoded root defense mechanism. They highlight how transient hormonal cues reprogram root architecture to limit pathogen invasion and suggest strategies for crop protection.

dynamicItems.title: Raman imaging of the phycosphere reveals sharp gradients of organic matter exuded by single phytoplankton cells
dynamicItems.abstract: Phytoplankton cells exude a wide array of chemicals in the water column, generating a localized microenvironment known as the phycosphere. Although it is now well accepted that the phycosphere mediates interactions between phytoplankton and bacteria, the chemical gradients around individual phytoplankton cells have never been explicitly measured, and their shape has been classically assumed to be set by ideal diffusion. Here we used Raman microspectroscopy to obtain micrometer-scale measurements of the concentration profile of a phytoplankton metabolite (fucoxanthin) around individual phytoplankton cells of different species, having radii between 2.5 and 60 μ m. We found that fucoxanthin concentration decreases more rapidly with distance from the cell than predicted by ideal diffusion, showing that the phycosphere includes compounds whose diffusion is characterized by nonideal effects. We explain this observation using a space-dependent diffusivity model where nonideality arises from viscosity and solubility gradients in the extracellular environment. Our results suggest an onion-structured model of the phycosphere, in which small hydrophilic solutes that obey ideal diffusion generate broad but weak gradients, whereas insoluble compounds are retained within 10 to 20 μ from the phytoplankton cell surface and yield steep gradients of organic matter. These observations, supported by evidence that fucoxanthin can act as an effective chemoattractant for marine bacteria, show the existence of strong and highly localized chemical cues with potentially far-reaching impacts on microbial interactions in aquatic environments. These findings highlight the importance of directly measuring the microscale chemical landscape experienced by marine microbes.
dynamicItems.summary: [背景] 浮游植物向水中释放多种化学物质，在其周围形成藻际（phycosphere）微环境。传统上认为藻际内的化学梯度由理想扩散决定，但缺乏直接、微米级的实验测量来验证。[方法] 该研究利用拉曼显微光谱技术，原位测量了不同物种（半径2.5–60 µm）的单个浮游植物细胞周围岩藻黄质（fucoxanthin）的浓度分布，并基于空间依赖扩散系数模型解释了非理想扩散现象。[发现] 1) 岩藻黄质浓度随离细胞距离的增加下降比理想扩散预测的更快，表明扩散受非理想因素（如粘度、溶解度梯度）影响。2) 提出“洋葱状”藻际结构模型：小型亲水性溶质遵循理想扩散形成宽广而微弱的梯度，而不溶性化合物则被局限在细胞表面10–20 µm范围内，形成陡峭的有机物梯度。3) 实验证据表明岩藻黄质可作为海洋细菌的有效化学引诱剂，突显了这些局部化学线索对微生物互作的潜在深远影响。[贡献] 首次在微米尺度下直接测量并证实了藻际化学梯度的非理想特征，挑战了经典理想扩散假说，为微生物生态学提供了新的机理解释。[局限] 研究仅限于一种代谢物（岩藻黄质）和有限的浮游植物种类，通用性待扩展；微环境物理化学因素（如湍流）的影响未纳入。信息不足，需查原文确认。[精读] 建议关注方法学部分：拉曼显微光谱在单细胞水平上的应用细节，以及空间扩散模型的构建与验证。

dynamicItems.title: Zero-deforestation commitments in Indonesia’s palm oil sector achieve high compliance but no additionality
dynamicItems.abstract: In response to public pressure, companies have increasingly adopted voluntary sustainable sourcing commitments. Yet, it often remains unclear whether such commitments lead only to the narrow goal of supplier compliance, or also to the broader goal of additionality, benefits beyond what would have occurred without commitments. We compiled a detailed dataset that integrates information about corporate ZDC implementation, supply chain linkages, and maps of palm-driven deforestation in Indonesia. dynamicItems.summary: [背景] 企业为应对公众压力而采用自愿性可持续采购承诺，但这类承诺的实际效果常不明确，可能仅实现供应商合规这一狭义目标，而未达成超越承诺前状况的额外性。印尼油棕行业是热带毁林的主要驱动力，评估其零毁林承诺（ZDC）的因果效应对保护政策至关重要。 [方法] 研究整合了企业ZDC实施信息、供应链联系数据及油棕特许地毁林地图，构建2018-2020年面板数据集，并使用双重差分等计量经济学方法评估ZDC对特许地毁林的因果影响。 [发现] 1) 与ZDC企业关联的特许地毁林率低，体现了高合规性；2) 然而，这些特许地在承诺前的毁林率已较低，承诺未带来显著的额外毁林减少，即没有额外性；3) 供应链复杂性可能限制企业影响供应商行为的能力，但相关数据有限。 [贡献] 首次通过细粒度供应链数据和因果推断，揭示了自愿性零毁林承诺在印尼的现实效果：虽能筛选低毁林供应商，却未能产生额外保护增益，对依赖此类承诺的保护策略提出警示。 [局限] 时间窗口较短（仅2018-2020年），长期效应未知；供应链数据覆盖率有限，可能遗漏间接供应商影响；未考虑承诺执行机制的差异。 [精读] 是否精读应依据自己的研究问题和方法需求判断。

dynamicItems.title: The role of viability selection in shaping short‐ and long‐term consequences of early‐life conditions: An experiment in the Alpine swift
dynamicItems.abstract: Abstract Environmental conditions experienced early in life can shape growth, morphology and survival, and can have lasting effects on individuals that survive to adulthood. Understanding how early‐life conditions affect fitness components across the life cycle is therefore essential for predicting variation in life‐history trajectories and their ecological and evolutionary consequences. We experimentally tested for short‐ and long‐term effects of early growth conditions by manipulating brood size in a wild population of the long‐lived Alpine swift Tachymarptis melba . Enlarging or reducing brood size alters sibling competition and per capita resource availability, with potential consequences on resource allocation between growth and self‐maintenance. We manipulated 45 pairs of broods between 2003 and 2006 and followed the offspring throughout their lives until 2019. Brood enlargement reduced average growth and survival, while increasing phenotypic variability among nestlings. Nestlings from enlarged broods were smaller, fledged later, and had lower survival to fledging and recruitment. Recruitment probability increased with nestling size, indicating strong selection on developmental phenotype. Consequently, nestlings from enlarged broods that recruited were a non‐random subset of bigger, higher‐quality individuals, and morphological differences between treatments disappeared among adults. Despite lower recruitment, individuals from enlarged broods showed equal or higher lifetime reproductive output, primarily through more frequent breeding attempts. Age‐specific analyses showed that reproductive performance patterns reflected both within‐individual changes and selective disappearance among individuals. We discuss how early‐life conditions shape life‐history trajectories through both developmental effects and selection acting before adulthood, arguing that apparent advantages in adult performance among individuals from harsher developmental environments arise from viability selection rather than beneficial effects of early‐life stress. Our findings show how missing‐fraction problems can bias inferences about fitness when early‐life mortality is ignored, highlighting the need to integrate early survival when evaluating the lifelong consequences of developmental environments.
authors: Bashar Jarayseh, Giulia Masoero, Pierre Bize
dynamicItems.summary: [背景] 早期环境条件能塑造个体的生长、形态和存活，并对其成年后的适合度产生持续影响，但存活至成年的个体往往经过强烈筛选，这种“缺失部分”可能导致对发育环境效应的推断产生偏差。[方法] 该研究在瑞士阿尔卑斯山的高山雨燕（Tachymarptis melba）野生种群中，通过2003–2006年对45对巢进行窝卵数操纵（扩大或缩小），改变雏鸟期同胞竞争和资源可得性，并追踪这些个体直到2019年的整个生活史，记录生长、存活、招募和繁殖表现。[发现] 1) 扩大窝卵数降低了雏鸟平均生长和存活率，但增加了表型变异；雏鸟更小、出飞更晚且招募率更低。2) 招募概率随雏鸟体型增大而升高，表明发育表型受到强烈存活选择；因此扩大窝组中成功招募的个体是非随机的、体型较大的高质量子集，成年后处理组间的形态差异消失。3) 尽管招募率低，扩大窝组个体成年后表现出同等或更高的终身繁殖产出，主要通过更频繁的繁殖尝试实现；年龄特化分析显示繁殖表现模式同时受个体内变化和选择性消失驱动。[贡献] 揭示了早期生活条件对生活史轨迹的影响并非通过直接发育效应，而是通过成年前的存活选择（viability selection）塑造了成年群体的组成，纠正了可观察到成年优势应归因于早期逆境的常见误判。[局限] 研究基于单一物种和单一环境，野外操纵未完全控制亲本质量等混杂因素，且部分长期生存数据可能受迁徙和重捕率影响。[精读] 该文清晰展示了如何通过长期数据区分选择效应和可塑性效应，其分析框架（如年龄特化模型、反事实推理）对研究生活史权衡和早期环境影响具有方法学参考价值，但若用户关注植物或群落尺度的干扰响应，则借鉴意义有限。

dynamicItems.title: Reduction in litter allelochemicals promotes positive biotic interactions among alien species
dynamicItems.abstract: Abstract A key focus of invasion ecology is elucidating why multiple alien species accumulate within ecosystems. The invasional meltdown hypothesis proposes that one alien invader promotes further invasions through soil legacy effects. However, whether microbial or litter legacies drive these effects, both of which are shaped by environmental heterogeneity (e.g., alien density or nutrient gradients), remains largely unexplored. We conducted a multifactorial experiment using an invasive plant species ( Phytolacca americana ) to assess how species origin affects alien plant invasion, incorporating two interacting species origins (native vs. alien), two litter treatments (with vs. without), two soil microbial conditions (inoculated vs. sterile), three soil phosphorus levels, and three planting density levels. Alien litter had lower total phenolic levels and higher C:N ratios than native litter. Phytolacca americana grew significantly better under alien litter. Path analysis revealed that this growth enhancement was driven primarily by reduced allelochemicals rather than nutrient differences, with plant density modulating this effect. Although soil microbial communities from different origins differed in diversity and functional structure, their inoculation produced no significant differential effects on P. americana growth. These results reveal a litter‐mediated mechanism that could potentially facilitate invasional meltdown by promoting positive interactions among alien plants. Our findings provide new insights into invasion mechanisms and highlight the ecological interplay between alien species. Read the free Plain Language Summary for this article on the Journal blog.

dynamicItems.title: Ecohydrological characteristics of biocrusts explain divergent responses of biocrusts and grasses to rainfall reduction
dynamicItems.abstract: Abstract Drylands are mainly structured by both vascular plants and biological soil crusts (biocrusts), the latter often regarded as a self‐organizing component of these ecosystems. Yet how the covers of these two components respond jointly to rainfall variability remains unclear—a critical gap for predicting future dryland resilience and carbon–water dynamics. To that end, we conducted a 4‐year rainfall reduction experiment (−75%, −50%, −25% and control) in a semi‐arid grassland with a large number of replicates, allowing a robust assessment of ecosystem responses under natural conditions. We found that grass cover responded mainly to rainfall reduction treatments, showing consistent declines due to their dependence on water input. Biocrust cover was more resilient to rainfall reduction but strongly promoted by years with more frequent rainfall events, reflecting their poikilohydric nature. Ecohydrological characteristics of biocrusts—specifically their rainfall thresholds for minimum carbon gain (carbon‐balancing rainfall size) and maximum water absorption (maximum usable rainfall size)—explained these divergent responses by mediating water availability. Synthesis . Our findings show that biocrusts mediate grass water supply by intercepting a significant fraction of rainfall; failing to account for this hydrological interaction leads to a biased overestimate of plant‐available water. This underscores the need to integrate biocrust‐plant interactions into experimental and modelling frameworks to improve predictions of dryland ecosystem sustainability under climate change. dynamicItems.title: Elevated CO2 advances vegetation phenology
dynamicItems.abstract: Abstract The continuous rise in atmospheric CO 2 concentration has profoundly altered vegetation structure and function across terrestrial ecosystems. Among various indicators, vegetation phenology is conventionally considered an early warning indicator of changes in other ecosystem processes. However, the relationship between vegetation phenology and elevated CO 2 (eCO 2 ) remains highly elusive. Here, we conducted a comprehensive meta‐analysis of 624 experimental records from 39 published studies to evaluate eCO 2 effects on vegetation phenology and quantify the relative importance of climate variables, soil factors, eCO 2 magnitude and experimental duration. The findings showed that eCO 2 significantly advanced overall vegetation phenology by 2.50 days (−1.99%), with leaf‐out advancing by 3.00 days (−2.38%) and maturity by 4.09 days (−3.24%). Elevated CO 2 exerted a negligible overall effect on plant growing season length. Importantly, model selection showed that plant functional groups were not essential predictors of phenological shifts. Instead, phenological shifts were primarily predicted by mean annual temperature (MAT) and eCO 2 magnitude. These results provide new insights into the mechanisms linking atmospheric change with plant developmental timing and highlight the need to explicitly incorporate CO 2 ‐driven phenological responses into ecosystem and Earth system models. dynamicItems.title: Interacting effects of water availability, neighbourhood density and ectomycorrhizal fungi on the traits and growth of a dominant Dipterocarp
dynamicItems.abstract: Abstract Southeast Asian forests are increasingly impacted by global change. Precipitation reduction is a key driver whose effects on tree performance are mediated by biotic contexts such as tree density and altered soil fungal communities. Understanding tree responses to these drivers is central to predicting forest dynamics. However, these drivers are often studied independently despite their potential for interactive effects. Trait‐based approaches that ignore these interactions by assuming static trait values may provide limited or biased insights into future forests. We manipulated three key variables in a glasshouse experiment: water availability (simulating decreasing precipitation) and two biotic contexts, neighbourhood density and soil ectomycorrhizal (EcM) fungal communities. We assessed their independent and interactive effects on the growth, traits and trait–growth relationships of Parashorea chinensis , a dominant Dipterocarp species in southeast Asian tropical rainforests. Our results demonstrate that, while water availability is the dominant driver of seedling growth, the impact is magnified by seedling density. Promotion of seedling growth by soil EcM fungi is observed under wet but not dry conditions. Seedling trait–growth relationships are highly context‐dependent, varying across treatments (i.e. water availability, neighbourhood density and fungicide). For instance, while root and stem traits exhibited weak or inconsistent relationships with growth, leaf traits such as leaf area and specific leaf area correlated strongly with growth across treatments. These findings indicate that predictions based upon static species‐level trait values will be highly uncertain, revealing that trait–performance relationships are more complex than assumed. Synthesis . Our results reveal that trait–growth relationships shift across water availability, neighbourhood density and soil biotas, challenging current vegetation models that rely on mean trait values. These findings highlight the need to move beyond single‐driver studies and static trait assumptions by integrating these factors to develop more robust predictions of future forest performance.

dynamicItems.title: Defaunation Maps for Tropical Mammals and Birds
dynamicItems.abstract: ABSTRACT Motivation Overhunting is a major driver of defaunation in tropical ecosystems, yet its impacts and spatial extent remain challenging to quantify through conventional remote sensing approaches. Novel modelling frameworks based on quantitative relationships between impacts on wildlife populations and the main drivers of hunting pressure have provided a mean to identify hotspots of defaunation for avian and mammalian communities at a pantropical scale. However, the absence of spatially explicit predictions of hunting impacts at the species level hinders comprehensive assessments of biodiversity loss. Here, we present species‐specific defaunation raster maps for 4992 birds and mammals. Main Types of Variables Contained Raw abundance datasets reporting paired abundance estimates in hunted and unhunted areas, year and location of data collection, reference of the original study, taxonomic information, and predictor variables. Defaunation index maps in raster format at 1 km × 1 km resolution for 3680 species of birds and 1312 species of mammals. Spatial Location Pantropical. Time Period and Grain 1980–2025 for the abundance estimates, 2020 for the defaunation rasters. Major Taxa and Level of Measurement Tropical bird and mammal species. Software Format One dataset in csv format with raw abundance estimates from local studies, 4992 raster files in tif format with defaunation values per grid cell.

dynamicItems.title: Regulating bark beetles with mechanical bark treatments: Trade‐offs among pest control, operational efficiency and biodiversity
dynamicItems.abstract: Abstract Natural disturbances have increasingly shaped global forests in recent decades. Coniferous forests in the Northern Hemisphere are facing intensifying disturbance regimes, exacerbating the conflict between traditional management objectives and the role of disturbance‐driven dynamics for biodiversity conservation. In Europe, unprecedented amounts of Norway spruce ( Picea abies ) have been damaged in recent years by hot droughts accompanied by outbreaks of the European Spruce Bark Beetle ( Ips typographus ). To meet the demands of forest protection and secure timber production, P. abies trees colonized by I. typographus , or suitable for colonization due to abiotic stress, are either extracted by salvage logging or made unsuitable for breeding using debarking techniques. Manual techniques are inefficient for large quantities and the extraction of deadwood can compromise biodiversity. We investigated mechanical bark treatments as potential alternatives to salvage logging for bark beetle regulation in Central Europe. Our study quantified bark beetle regulation efficacy, operational efficiency, wood properties and effects on biodiversity of saproxylic beetles, fungi and bacteria, as well as woodpeckers. Processing Norway spruce logs three times with a harvester to remove bark substantially reduced bark beetle emergence, demonstrating a scalable method that may contribute to the management of pest outbreaks and disturbances at landscape scales. Motor‐manual bark gouging and debarking are flexible alternatives and effective methods for small wood quantities. With increasing bark removal intensity, species richness of saproxylic beetles and bacteria decreased, while fungi species richness increased. In all three groups, species assemblages were affected by bark treatments. Differences in moisture content between treated and control logs were the main driver for changes in fungi and bacteria community assemblages. Bark treatments did not affect net calorific value over the first 2 years, blue‐stain fungi colonization and elemental composition (H, C and N). Synthesis and applications . Three times harvester processing and motor‐manual bark gouging effectively reduce bark beetles, enabling two options: permanent on‐site retention for biodiversity conservation, or up to 2 years of intermediate on‐site storage with no treatment effect on blue‐stain fungi colonization or energy content, thereby buffering operational bottlenecks during landscape disturbances.

dynamicItems.title: A quantitative analysis to detect mass mortality events (wrecks) in Procellariiformes
dynamicItems.abstract: Abstract Mass mortality events (MMEs) or ‘wrecks’ represent sudden and large‐scale mortality episodes often associated with extreme environmental conditions. Despite their ecological importance, MMEs remain poorly documented in the South Atlantic, particularly for Procellariiformes, a group highly vulnerable to climate‐driven anomalies. Detecting such events in this region is challenging because baseline mortality levels are unknown, limiting the ability of monitoring programs to identify abnormal mortality episodes. We developed a quantitative framework to detect and characterize seabird MMEs by integrating time‐series decomposition, changepoint analysis and kernel density estimation. The framework was applied to 8 years (2017–2024) of standardized beach monitoring data covering approximately 3320 km of the Brazilian coastline. This approach allowed us to identify anomalous mortality peaks, estimate the temporal duration of mortality episodes and delineate their spatial extent and hotspots along the coast. We detected seven previously unreported MMEs impacting 3779 stranded Procellariiformes. Events occurred primarily during austral autumn in northeastern and during austral spring in southeastern–southern regions, revealing recurrent seasonal and spatial patterns. Cory's Shearwater Calonectris borealis , Manx Shearwater Puffinus puffinus and Atlantic Yellow‐nosed Albatross Thalassarche chlororhynchos were the most affected species, with juveniles disproportionately represented. Kernel density analysis identified recurrent hotspot regions of mortality along the Brazilian coast. We propose mortality thresholds in an early‐warning system to guide monitoring efforts during abnormal stranding events. Synthesis and applications . Our study provides the first systematic assessment of seabird mass mortality events in the South Atlantic and introduces a transferable statistical framework for detecting MMEs in other taxa and regions lacking baseline mortality information. By identifying recurrent temporal anomalies, high‐risk areas and vulnerable species, we could establish quantitative indicators of MMEs. This approach offers a practical tool for monitoring programs to improve early detection of mortality events and to implement rapid response protocols.

dynamicItems.title: Do field margins matter more than floral resources? Arthropod activity and limited spillover of natural enemies from perennial flower strips into adjacent crops
dynamicItems.abstract: Abstract The simplification of agricultural landscapes and widespread pesticide use are major drivers of biodiversity loss, particularly affecting beneficial arthropods that provide essential ecosystem services such as pollination and natural pest control. Flower strips have emerged as a promising agri‐environmental measure to mitigate these effects by offering floral resources, shelter and overwintering habitats. However, their effectiveness depends on multiple factors, including plant species composition, strip age, cutting regime, and the dispersal of natural enemies into adjacent crops. In a three‐year field study (2022–2024) in conventionally managed agricultural fields, we examined arthropod activity in perennial flower strips, control grass strips and adjacent crops (sugar beet and cereals). In spring, arthropods were sampled to assess overwintering success; in summer, we investigated arthropod activity with a focus on natural enemies and their dispersal from field margins into adjacent crops. Overall arthropod activity did not differ consistently between flower and grass strips; though certain natural enemy groups showed a preference for flower strips. A strong edge effect was observed, with arthropod activity consistently higher within strips and declining rapidly within 5 m into the crop. Spillover of natural enemies was comparable between flower and grass strips, though activity declined more sharply from five to 50 m from the grass strip in 2023 and 2024, suggesting a more sustained activity gradient near flower strips. Some groups showed higher activity densities at 5 m distances compared to 50 m distances indicating that a spillover from the margin exists but declines rapidly. Arthropod activity peaked in 2022, reflecting inter‐annual variability. Overwintering success was comparable in flower and grass strips, and overall increased from 2023 to 2024, the second and third years since strip establishment. Synthesis and applications . Both flower and grass strips supported significantly higher arthropod activity than adjacent crop fields, underlining the general ecological value of field margins regardless of floral composition. The observed group‐specific responses emphasize the need for taxa‐specific analyses within heterogeneous functional groups, rather than relying solely on aggregated patterns. While tailored flower strips can promote specific natural enemy groups and local arthropod conservation, their contribution to biological control is conditional on pest pressure and landscape context, temporally variable, and likely most effective in low‐input or organic systems where pesticide pressure does not suppress in‐field arthropod activity.
authors: Constanze Ohlendorf, Jörn Lehmhus, Christoph Joachim
dynamicItems.summary: [背景] 农业景观简化和农药使用导致有益节肢动物（如传粉者和天敌）减少，花带被认为可提供花资源、庇护所和越冬地，但其效果受植物组成、带龄、割草制度及天敌向作物扩散能力的影响。[方法] 本研究在2022–2024年间，于集约化管理农田中设置多年生花带和对照草带，并在相邻甜菜和谷物田中调查节肢动物活动及天敌扩散。春、夏季分别采样评估越冬成功和活动密度，重点关注天敌类群和从田缘向作物内部的溢出格局。[发现] 1) 花带与草带间节肢动物总体活动密度无显著差异，但某些天敌类群（如部分寄生蜂）在花带中更活跃；2) 田缘内部节肢动物活动显著高于邻近作物，存在强烈的边缘效应，活动密度在进入作物5 m内快速下降；3) 天敌溢出效应在花带和草带间相似，但草带附近活动从5 m至50 m下降更迅速，暗示花带可维持稍持久的梯度；4) 年际变化明显，2022年活动最高；5) 越冬成功率在花带和草带中相当，且随带龄（第二、三年）增加。[贡献] 揭示了无论花资源多寡，田间边缘均具有显著的生态保育价值，并强调针对不同功能类群需进行分类分析，而非仅依赖聚合指标。[局限] 本研究在常规管理农田进行，未直接量化生物防治效果；天敌溢出对害虫控制的实际贡献受害虫密度和景观背景制约，且在低投入或有机系统中可能更有效。[精读] 值得关注多年生花带的长期效应和类群特异性响应，可参考其实验设计和类群分析方法。

dynamicItems.title: Extending the leaf economics spectrum: Freshwater plant communities exhibit realm‐specific leaf adaptations
dynamicItems.abstract: Abstract The leaf economics spectrum bridges plant demography with terrestrial biodiversity gradients, community ecology and ecosystem functions, providing a framework for the mechanisms underlying ecosystem change. However, our understanding of whether this framework applies to aquatic plant communities and how their biogeography is shaped by their unique adaptations to life in water is limited. Moreover, it remains unclear whether leaf trait expression of aquatic plants responds to changes in environmental conditions differently depending on their life form (i.e. emergent, submerged). Here, we compiled a dataset of community composition for 6953 lake and river plant communities across Europe. We appended leaf trait data and environmental data to each community. Then, we calculated the community mean traits for emergent and submerged plant communities to determine their position along the leaf economics spectrum and how they deviate from terrestrial expectations. We used Gaussian multivariate mixed linear regression models to investigate life form‐specific variation in trait‐environment relationships. We find that emergent communities exhibit trait–environment relationships comparable to terrestrial predictions, with high bicarbonate and phosphorus concentrations, and warm temperatures selecting for acquisitive leaf traits. In contrast, acquisitive submerged communities are selected for by high bicarbonate and low temperature, and not by phosphorus availability. We attribute these differences to freshwater‐specific adaptations which influence the leaf economics of submerged communities more profoundly than emergent communities, since submerged plants grow in particularly challenging conditions with respect to light and gas availability. These findings suggest that aquatic plants have adaptations to their unique environments that require trade‐offs between leaf form and function to facilitate underwater metabolism, which pushes the boundaries of the leaf economics spectrum. Synthesis . Our ability to apply existing knowledge of leaf economics based on terrestrial plants to the aquatic realm is limited, especially with respect to the influence of temperature on plant growth, which is key for predicting the impacts of climate change on vegetation globally. Our findings highlight the importance of a realm‐specific approach for linking functional traits to freshwater ecosystem functioning and biodiversity, as the distinct responses of freshwater plants to their environment are not captured by terrestrial‐derived frameworks.

dynamicItems.summary: [背景] 叶经济谱是连接植物生活史策略与生态系统功能的核心框架，但主要基于陆生植物建立，其在淡水植物群落中的适用性及水生环境独特适应是否改变这些关系尚不清晰。不同生活型（挺水、沉水）可能对环境驱动呈差异化响应，而现有理论难以捕捉。 [方法] 本研究整合了欧洲6953个湖泊与河流植物群落的组成数据，附加叶性状和环境变量，计算挺水与沉水群落的均值性状，并利用高斯多元混合线性回归模型分别分析两类生活型叶性状与环境因子的关系，比较其相对于陆生预测的偏移。 [发现] 1) 挺水植物群落的叶性状–环境关系与陆生预测相似，高重碳酸盐、高磷和温暖条件选择资源获取型性状；2) 沉水植物群落则不同，获取型性状与高重碳酸盐和低温相关，而与磷有效性无关；3) 水生植物特有的水下气体交换和光限制等适应迫使叶形态与功能间存在独特权衡，突破了叶经济谱的原有边界，尤其表现在沉水植物上；4) 温度对水生植物生长的影响方向与陆生植物相反，提示在全球变化预测中不可直接套用陆生框架。 [贡献] 首次明确提出淡水植物叶经济谱具有领域特异性，强调了生活型在预测环境响应中的关键作用，为将功能性状方法拓展至淡水生态系统提供了新证据，并呼吁气候影响评估中需区分水生与陆生系统。 [局限] 欧洲尺度数据可能限制向其他地区的推广性；未涵盖其他可能重要的环境因子（如水流、沉积物性质），且性状数据基于数据库而非原位测量，可能引入误差。 [精读] 值得阅读其讨论部分关于水生生境如何重塑温度–性状关系的机制阐述，以及对叶经济谱概念拓展的理论贡献。

dynamicItems.title: Global threats, local opportunities: ice‐related landforms provide refugia for high‐elevation plants and arthropods
dynamicItems.abstract: Ice‐related landforms in mountain areas have been hypothesized to play a key role in the survival of cold‐adapted species threatened by climate change. However, our understanding of such landforms acting as refugia remains speculative. Here we analyse occurrence data, collected through a standardized sampling at 471 sampling points across the European Alps in relation to landform type and other environmental predictors, to identify the drivers of local presence for 209 high‐elevation plant and arthropod species. Forty‐three species show a negative response to temperature; the occurrence of debris‐covered glaciers and rock glaciers weakens the negative relationship with temperature of nine of them (21%). This finding highlights the role of ice‐related landforms for the survival of an important fraction of species threatened by climate change, although their role is taxon‐related, being maximum for carabid beetles and not observed for spiders. Fine‐scale landscape heterogeneity therefore plays a key role in mediating species responses to climate change. By integrating ecological and geographic perspectives, this study provides a framework for identifying refugia and assessing their biodiversity to target conservation measures for mountain areas worldwide.
authors: Mauro Gobbi, Barbara Valle, Mattia Brambilla, Duccio Tampucci, Marco Caccianiga

dynamicItems.title: Rebuilding the species pool within a phylogenetic framework
dynamicItems.abstract: The species pool is a fundamental concept with the potential to connect ecological and evolutionary processes in community ecology and biogeography. However, current definitions of the concept primarily focus on contemporary ecological processes, ignoring the historical and evolutionary processes that generated the species pool. We propose a phylogenetic framework that defines the species pool by inferring evolutionary connectivity between communities in a biogeographic region. Our framework is better suited to addressing questions regarding assembly processes occurring over long time periods, offering deeper evolutionary insights for community ecology and conservation biogeography.
authors: Sijia Yuan, Yuhao Zhao, Jean-Philippe Lessard, Thomas E. Martin, Thomas J. Matthews, Xingfeng Si
dynamicItems.summary: [背景] 物种池概念是群落生态学与生物地理学的核心，连接生态与进化过程，但现有定义主要关注当代生态过程，忽略了生成物种池的历史与进化过程。 [方法] 本文提出一个系统发育框架，通过推断生物地理区域内群落间的进化连接性来定义物种池，强调长期进化尺度的组装过程。 [发现] 该框架能够整合系统发育信息与生物地理分布数据，揭示区域种库的进化组成与群落间进化关系，为理解群落构建机制提供时间深度。 [贡献] 首次将系统发育维度系统性地纳入物种池概念，为群落生态学引入历史与进化视角，拓展了概念在保护生物地理学中的应用。 [局限] 框架依赖高质量的系统发育树和分布数据，在数据不足的类群或区域可能受限，且未提供具体实证检验。 [精读] 概念框架值得关注，尤其方法学部分对进化群落生态学者有启发，但需结合具体研究案例进一步评估适用性。

dynamicItems.title: Geographic variation in diaspore traits and home‐site advantage in ant‐mediated dispersal
dynamicItems.abstract: Abstract Ant‐mediated seed dispersal (myrmecochory) is a widespread mutualism in which ants selectively transport diaspores based on their morphological and chemical traits. Although diaspore traits are proposed to reflect adaptation to local ant communities, empirical evidence linking geographic variation in these traits to dispersal outcomes remains limited. Here, we investigated population differentiation in diaspore traits and their consequences for ant‐mediated dispersal in the myrmecochorous plant Coreanomecon hylomeconoides , an endemic species of the Korean Peninsula. We assessed geographic variation in diaspore mass‐related traits and elaiosome fatty acid composition across seven natural populations. In addition, we conducted reciprocal cafeteria experiments across the habitats of these populations, in which diaspores from different source populations were simultaneously offered to ants at both home and away sites. Time to diaspore removal by ants was used as a proxy for a fitness component and was analysed using mixed‐effects Cox proportional hazards models. Diaspore traits varied significantly among populations, including traits that may influence ant‐carrying behaviour. Ant‐mediated diaspore removal depended on source population at four of the seven sites, with marginal evidence at one additional site. Among these five sites, diaspores from the local population were removed more rapidly than those from non‐local populations at three sites, consistent with a home‐site advantage, whereas such an advantage was absent at the other two sites. Mass‐related diaspore traits influenced ant removal responses, but the strength and direction of these effects differed among sites. Chemical traits related to fatty acid composition affected ant behaviour at two of the five sites included in trait‐based analyses. Synthesis . Our results demonstrate that ant‐mediated selection on diaspore traits varies geographically, possibly resulting in uneven expression of home‐site advantage across populations. This spatial heterogeneity is consistent with predictions from the geographic mosaic theory of coevolution and highlights the importance of evolutionary ecological context in shaping mutualistic interactions across a species' range.

dynamicItems.title: Effect of cellular nutrient economy on the evolution of genome size in phytoplankton
dynamicItems.abstract: The origin of genome size variation remains a central question in evolutionary biology. While energetic costs have been proposed to influence genome size through selection on insertions and deletions (indels), nutrient availability may be a more relevant constraint in primary producers such as phytoplankton. We derived an expression for the selection coefficient of indels based on the phosphorus and nitrogen costs of nucleotides and the cellular nutrient requirements. Selection coefficient estimates indicate that natural selection dominates over genetic drift and favors the fixation of mutations that reduce genome size in phytoplankton with low nutrient requirements. Model predictions are supported by comparative genomics and metagenomic analyses. Together, this model provides a rigorous quantitative framework for understanding genome size evolution, particularly in small cells and oligotrophic environments, highlighting how nutrient limitation drives genome streamlining.
dynamicItems.summary: [背景] 基因组大小变异是进化生物学的核心问题之一，现有假说多强调能量成本对插入缺失突变的选择，但在浮游植物等初级生产者中，营养限制可能更为关键。[方法] 本研究推导了基于核苷酸磷、氮成本及细胞营养需求的插入缺失突变选择系数模型，并结合比较基因组学与宏基因组数据验证。[发现] 模型显示，在低营养需求的浮游植物中，自然选择占主导地位，倾向于固定减小基因组大小的突变；该预测在小细胞和寡营养环境类群中得到支持。[贡献] 提供了一个整合营养经济与基因组进化的定量框架，首次将细胞层面的营养需求与基因组大小演化联系起来。[局限] 模型主要针对浮游植物，外推到其他营养限制环境或更大生物体需谨慎；未考虑基因重复等其它基因组变化机制。[精读] 是否精读应依据自己的研究问题和方法需求判断。
